name: ATTENSURE PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR Syrup 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About ATTENSURE PEPPERMINT FLAVOUR SYRUP

Attensure Syrup is a nutritional supplement used as a novel therapy to alleviate the symptoms in attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) patients. It contains caffeine and melatonin as active ingredients that helps to make hyperactive children calm and more concentrated.

Caffeine can improve focus and attention span, that helps to control impulsive behaviour. Caffeine raises the number of chemical messengers such as dopamine in brain that improves pleasure, attention and movement. Melatonin helps to overcome sleep disturbances.

Always take Attensure Syrup as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. It is advised to take 5ml of Attensure Syrup once daily at 4PM or as directed by your physician. Do not exceed the stated recommended daily dosage.
author: Dr. R. Dinesh John Rajkumar

name: Zolfresh 10mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET Works

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET

Take ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Such birth defects include cleft lip, cleft palate, reduced foetal movement and foetal heart rate variability, muscle weakness, low body temperature (hypothermia), difficulty feeding and breathing problems (respiratory depression). Consult your doctor before taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET.
ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if your feel dizzy, drowsy, sleepy, confused, blurring of vision, or less alert after taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET. Consult your doctor for advice.

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET.
ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET.
Do not take ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Zopiclone or lactose or other lactose other ingredients in the medicine.

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients with severe respiratory disorders or breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET.
ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from heart diseases including slow or uneven heartbeat. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET.

Others

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Mental illness or psychosis or depression

Before taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Depression and any other mental illness
Drug abuse
Plans to take a blood test to check liver function

Fits

Use in geriatrics:

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients more than 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antipsychotics such as clozapine, haloperidol, and chlorpromazine (medicines used to manage mental illness)
Antidepressants such as sertraline, venlafaxine, fluoxetine, bupropion, and desipramine (medicines used to manage depression)
Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)
Opioids such as codeine, methadone, tramadol, pethidine, oxycodone, and morphine (medicines used for severe pain and cough)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Ketoconazole, and itraconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Overdosage:

If you or anybody else accidentally take too much ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET, consult your doctor or visit the nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of overdose are drowsiness, confusion, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.

name: Zopicon Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZOPICON TABLET

ZOPICON TABLET contains Zopiclone which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics and Sedatives. It is indicated for the short-term management and symptomatic relief of insomnia characterized by difficulty in falling asleep, frequent nocturnal awakenings and or early morning awakenings.

Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep. You may still feel tired when you wake up. It also affects your health, work performance and quality of life.

ZOPICON TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping) and in patients who had stroke. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPICON TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from depression or any other mental illness, personality disorder, kidney disease, somnambulism (sleep walking), thyroid disorder, epilepsy (seizures). Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPICON TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZOPICON TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPICON TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ZOPICON TABLET are dry mouth, bitter or metallic taste, feeling sleepy or drowsy, headache and fatigue, dizziness, lightheadedness and difficulty with coordination. Contact your doctor if you get any side effects. Specific serious side effects include suicidal thoughts in some patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience such thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOPICON TABLET
Manage insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOPICON TABLET Works

ZOPICON TABLET helps to improve your sleep by binding to benzodiazepine receptors in brain and increases the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA (a neurotransmitter helps to transfer messages in the brain) and produces a calming effect on the brain. Thus, helps to manage sleep disorders.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOPICON TABLET

Take ZOPICON TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: ZOPICON TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause harm to the unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking.
ZOPICON TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass into the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking.
ZOPICON TABLET may cause drowsiness which can affect your ability to drive and operate machines. Do not drive or operate machines after taking ZOPICON TABLET.

ZOPICON TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have history of alcohol abuse. Consumption of alcohol is not advised while taking this medicine as it increases sleepiness. Consult your doctor before taking.
ZOPICON TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking.
ZOPICON TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver diseases. Consult your doctor before taking.
Do not take ZOPICON TABLET if you are allergic to Zopiclone or to other ingredients of medicine.

ZOPICON TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients suffering from severe respiratory disorders. Consult your doctor before taking.

Others

ZOPICON TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Had stroke
Ever experienced sleepwalking or other unusual behaviour while not being fully awake after taking ZOPICON TABLET

Before taking ZOPICON TABLET inform your doctor if you have:

Personality disorder
Depression and any other mental illness such as psychoses, schizophrenia
A history of drug abuse
Periodic limb movement disorder (involuntary moving the limbs in sleep)
Restless legs syndrome (an urge to move legs constantly)
Surgery or anaesthesia
Somnambulism (sleep walking)
Thyroid disorder
Epilepsy (seizures)

Use in paediatrics:

ZOPICON TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

Use in geriatrics:

ZOPICON TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as they are more susceptible to the sedative effects of this medicine associated with giddiness, ataxia and confusion, which may increase the possibility of a fall. Consult your doctor before taking.

Symptoms of severe overdosage are low blood pressure, respiratory disorder or shallow breathing or difficulty breathing, weak muscle tone, methemoglobinemia (increased methaemoglobin in blood), ataxia (impaired coordination). Consult your immediately if you experience any of these symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET

SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET Works

SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET

Take SOBRIUM 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET.

Do not drive or operate any machines if your feel dizzy, drowsy, sleepy, confused, blurring of vision, or less alert after taking INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET. Consult your doctor for advice.

Do not consume alcohol while taking INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET as it can cause difficulty in breathing or walking, or put you in a very deep sleep. Consult your doctor before taking INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET.

Kidney

INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET.

Liver

INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET.

Allergy

Do not take INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Zopiclone or lactose or other lactose other ingredients in the medicine.

Lungs

INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients with severe respiratory disorders or breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor before taking INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET.

Heart Disease

INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from heart diseases including slow or uneven heartbeat. Consult your doctor before taking INZOFRESH 10MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET

ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET contains Etizolam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is used in the management of short-term anxiety. Anxiety is a mental health disease characterized by fear, worry, and excessive nervousness.

ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET is also used to manage insomnia. Insomnia is a sleep disease that causes trouble in falling asleep or staying asleep.

ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET can have a serious side effect like suicidal thoughts, consult your doctor immediately if you have suicidal or aggressive thoughts.

ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease, lung diseases, myasthenia gravis, acute narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye), chronic psychosis, or porphyria.

Before taking ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, alcohol addiction, or personality disorders. ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET can be used in children and adolescents. However, consult with your child’s doctor before giving it to your child.

In elderly patients, ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET should be used with caution. The most common side effects of taking ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET are decreased heart rate, impaired coordination, sleepiness, yawning, decreased appetite, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth and headache. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET Works

ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET work by increasing the activity of GABA (a chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent) and inducing sleep. Thereby, relaxes muscles, reduces anxiety, and helps to fall asleep.
usageDetails:
How to use ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET

Take ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET as advised by your physician. Take this medicine with or without meals.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet, Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take ETILAAM 1.5 CR TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About NITROSUN 10MG TABLET

NITROSUN 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITROSUN 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITROSUN 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITROSUN 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITROSUN 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITROSUN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITROSUN 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITROSUN 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITROSUN 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITROSUN 10MG TABLET.

How NITROSUN 10MG TABLET Works

NITROSUN 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.

Do not stop taking NITROSUN 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Introduction About NITZY 10MG TABLET

NITZY 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITZY 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITZY 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITZY 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITZY 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITZY 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITZY 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITZY 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITZY 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITZY 10MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How NITZY 10MG TABLET Works

NITZY 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.

Take NITZY 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITZY 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Introduction About SOVE 10MG TABLET

SOVE 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

SOVE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

SOVE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

SOVE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. SOVE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. SOVE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking SOVE 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOPITRAN 7.5MG TABLET

ZOPITRAN 7.5MG TABLET contains Zopiclone which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics and Sedatives. It is indicated for the short-term management and symptomatic relief of insomnia characterized by difficulty in falling asleep, frequent nocturnal awakenings and or early morning awakenings.

Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep. You may still feel tired when you wake up. It also affects your health, work performance and quality of life.

ZOPITRAN 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping) and in patients who had stroke. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPITRAN 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from depression or any other mental illness, personality disorder, kidney disease, somnambulism (sleep walking), thyroid disorder, epilepsy (seizures). Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPITRAN 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZOPITRAN 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPITRAN 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ZOPITRAN 7.5MG TABLET are dry mouth, bitter or metallic taste, feeling sleepy or drowsy, headache and fatigue, dizziness, lightheadedness and difficulty with coordination. Introduction About ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLFRESH 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

introduction:
Introduction About NITRAVET 10MG TABLET

NITRAVET 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITRAVET 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITRAVET 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITRAVET 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITRAVET 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITRAVET 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITRAVET 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITRAVET 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITRAVET 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITRAVET 10MG TABLET.

Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.

Introduction About NIPAM 10MG TABLET

NIPAM 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NIPAM 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NIPAM 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NIPAM 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NIPAM 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NIPAM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NIPAM 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NIPAM 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NIPAM 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NIPAM 10MG TABLET.

How NIPAM 10MG TABLET Works

NIPAM 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET

ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET contains Zopiclone which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics and Sedatives. It is indicated for the short-term management and symptomatic relief of insomnia characterized by difficulty in falling asleep, frequent nocturnal awakenings and or early morning awakenings.

Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep. You may still feel tired when you wake up. It also affects your health, work performance and quality of life.

ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping) and in patients who had stroke. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from depression or any other mental illness, personality disorder, kidney disease, somnambulism (sleep walking), thyroid disorder, epilepsy (seizures). Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET are dry mouth, bitter or metallic taste, feeling sleepy or drowsy, headache and fatigue, dizziness, lightheadedness and difficulty with coordination. Contact your doctor if you get any side effects. Specific serious side effects include suicidal thoughts in some patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience such thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET
Manage insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET Works

ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET helps to improve your sleep by binding to benzodiazepine receptors in brain and increases the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA (a neurotransmitter helps to transfer messages in the brain) and produces a calming effect on the brain. Thus, helps to manage sleep disorders.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET

Take ZOLIUM 7.5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET

NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET Works

NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET

Take NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Have any breathing difficulties
Have sleep apnea (breathing difficulties during sleep)
Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness and tenderness)
Have any psychiatric disorders (such as schizophrenia)
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Before taking NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are in depression or have a history of depression
Have anxiety or any other mental illnesses
Are alcoholic
Have low albumin levels in blood
Have poor blood supply to the brain
Have epilepsy
Have an history of alcoholism or drug abuse

NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor for advice.

NITROSUM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as it could relax the muscles and increase the risk of fall or injuries in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About NITROSUN 5MG TABLET

NITROSUN 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITROSUN 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITROSUN 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITROSUN 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITROSUN 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITROSUN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITROSUN 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITROSUN 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITROSUN 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITROSUN 5MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)

Uses Of NITROSUN 5MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)
Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
mechanismOfAction:
How NITROSUN 5MG TABLET Works

NITROSUN 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NITROSUN 5MG TABLET

Take NITROSUN 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITROSUN 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

name: Ziclone 7.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET

ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET contains Zopiclone which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics and Sedatives. It is indicated for the short-term management and symptomatic relief of insomnia characterized by difficulty in falling asleep, frequent nocturnal awakenings and or early morning awakenings.

Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep. You may still feel tired when you wake up. It also affects your health, work performance and quality of life.

ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping) and in patients who had stroke. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from depression or any other mental illness, personality disorder, kidney disease, somnambulism (sleep walking), thyroid disorder, epilepsy (seizures). Consult your doctor before taking.

ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET are dry mouth, bitter or metallic taste, feeling sleepy or drowsy, headache and fatigue, dizziness, lightheadedness and difficulty with coordination. Contact your doctor if you get any side effects. Specific serious side effects include suicidal thoughts in some patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience such thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET
Manage insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET Works

ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET helps to improve your sleep by binding to benzodiazepine receptors in brain and increases the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA (a neurotransmitter helps to transfer messages in the brain) and produces a calming effect on the brain. Thus, helps to manage sleep disorders.
usageDetails:
How to use ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET

Take ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients suffering from severe respiratory disorders. Consult your doctor before taking.

Others

ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Had stroke
Ever experienced sleepwalking or other unusual behaviour while not being fully awake after taking ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET

Before taking ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have:

Personality disorder
Depression and any other mental illness such as psychoses, schizophrenia
A history of drug abuse
Periodic limb movement disorder (involuntary moving the limbs in sleep)
Restless legs syndrome (an urge to move legs constantly)
Surgery or anaesthesia
Somnambulism (sleep walking)
Thyroid disorder
Epilepsy (seizures)

Use in paediatrics:

ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

Use in geriatrics:

ZICLONE 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as they are more susceptible to the sedative effects of this medicine associated with giddiness, ataxia and confusion, which may increase the possibility of a fall. Consult your doctor before taking.

NITREST 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. NITREST 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking NITREST 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)

introduction:
Introduction About MEDZOL INJECTION

MEDZOL INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MEDZOL INJECTION. Do not receive MEDZOL INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MEDZOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MEDZOL INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MEDZOL INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEDZOL INJECTION Works

MEDZOL INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MEDZOL INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

How to use MEDZOL INJECTION

MEDZOL INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET

DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

Introduction About DORMIN 10MG TABLET

DORMIN 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

DORMIN 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take DORMIN 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking DORMIN 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking DORMIN 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

DORMIN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

DORMIN 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking DORMIN 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking DORMIN 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking DORMIN 10MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How DORMIN 10MG TABLET Works

DORMIN 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking DORMIN 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness and tenderness)
Have any psychiatric disorders (such as schizophrenia)
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Are alcoholic
Have low albumin levels in blood
Have poor blood supply to the brain
Have epilepsy

DORMIN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics

DORMIN 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as it could relax the muscles and increase the risk of fall or injuries in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

NAP 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NAP 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NAP 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NAP 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NAP 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NAP 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NAP 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NAP 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NAP 10MG TABLET.

How NAP 10MG TABLET Works

NAP 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.

Take NAP 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NAP 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

introduction:
Introduction About DACTIVE 10MG TABLET

DACTIVE 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

DACTIVE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

DACTIVE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

DACTIVE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. DACTIVE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. DACTIVE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking DACTIVE 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

Uses Of DACTIVE 10MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How DACTIVE 10MG TABLET Works

DACTIVE 10MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take DACTIVE 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET

LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET contains Zopiclone which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics and Sedatives. It is indicated for the short-term management and symptomatic relief of insomnia characterized by difficulty in falling asleep, frequent nocturnal awakenings and or early morning awakenings.

Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep. You may still feel tired when you wake up. It also affects your health, work performance and quality of life.

LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping) and in patients who had stroke. Consult your doctor before taking.

LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from depression or any other mental illness, personality disorder, kidney disease, somnambulism (sleep walking), thyroid disorder, epilepsy (seizures). Consult your doctor before taking.

LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET are dry mouth, bitter or metallic taste, feeling sleepy or drowsy, headache and fatigue, dizziness, lightheadedness and difficulty with coordination. Contact your doctor if you get any side effects. Specific serious side effects include suicidal thoughts in some patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience such thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET
Manage insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET Works

LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET helps to improve your sleep by binding to benzodiazepine receptors in brain and increases the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA (a neurotransmitter helps to transfer messages in the brain) and produces a calming effect on the brain. Thus, helps to manage sleep disorders.
usageDetails:
How to use LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET

Take LYZOP 7.5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NITAVAN 5MG TABLET

NITAVAN 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITAVAN 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITAVAN 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITAVAN 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITAVAN 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITAVAN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITAVAN 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITAVAN 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITAVAN 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITAVAN 5MG TABLET.

How NITAVAN 5MG TABLET Works

NITAVAN 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.

Take NITAVAN 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITAVAN 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NIGAP 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NIGAP 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NIGAP 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NIGAP 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NIGAP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NIGAP 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NIGAP 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NIGAP 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET

MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET contains Mirtazapine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is used in adults to manage depression. Depression is a mood disorder characterized by persistent feeling of sadness, loss of interest, feeling guilty or worthless, attention impairment, lack of energy, suicidal thoughts and slow or abnormal physical movements.

MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without meals. It may take around 1-2 weeks for MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET to start working and you may notice improvement in your condition only after 2-4 weeks of therapy. Therefore, take MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET for the duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have jaundice, diabetes, glaucoma, low blood pressure, previous history of fits, suicidal thoughts or other mental illnesses (such as manic depression or schizophrenia) as a precaution.

Avoid concomitant use of MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET with other antidepressants (MAO inhibitor) without consulting your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, weight gain, headache, constipation, dry mouth, problems in sleeping, tremors, anxiety, confusion, joint pain and muscle pain. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if your depression worsens or if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET.

MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET is an antidepressant medication. It acts by increasing the levels of certain chemical messengers (such as serotonin and norepinephrine) in the brain that can stabilize mood and mental health. As a result, it improves your mood and energy and reduce the signs of depression.

Take MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablets: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablets: Disperse the medicine in the required amount of water as mentioned in the product label. Consume the mixture immediately after dispersion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking MIRAMIND 7.5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as vomiting, dizziness, agitation, anxiety or headaches.

NIGAP 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). Before taking NIGAP 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NIGAP 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NIGAP 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NIGAP 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NIGAP 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NIGAP 10MG TABLET.

How NIGAP 10MG TABLET Works

NIGAP 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. ZOLFRESH CR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLFRESH CR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLFRESH CR 6.25MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ZOLFRESH CR 6.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)

Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)

Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

introduction:
Introduction About DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET

DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET Works

DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET

Take DACTIVE 6.25MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SZETALO PLUS TABLET

SZETALO PLUS TABLETcontains a combination of Clonazepam and Escitalopram which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is indicated for the management of comorbid depression and anxiety disorder.

Comorbid depression and anxiety disorder is condition in which the person has anxiety and depression together at the same time. Symptoms are persistent feeling of sadness or loss of interest, changes in sleep, appetite, energy level, concentration or daily behavior, feeling nervous or restless, fast heartrate, heavy breathing.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with SZETALO PLUS TABLET. SZETALO PLUS TABLET is not recommended to use in patients having liver or heart diseases, acute narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure within the eye) or if you are taking MAO inhibitors such as isocarboxazid or moclobemide (to manage depression), selegiline (used to manage Parkinson’s disease) or linezolid (an antibiotic).

Before taking SZETALO PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver or, lung diseases, epilepsy, low levels of sodium, tendency of bleeding and bruising and diabetes. Patients should be monitored for signs of suicidal ideation and behaviors and advised to seek immediate medical advice if any such signs occur.

SZETALO PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking it. SZETALO PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (18 years and below).SZETALO PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SZETALO PLUS TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhea, constipation, dry mouth, increased sweating, increased or decreased appetite, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists.
uses: Manage comorbid depression and anxiety disorder
usesDetails:
Uses Of SZETALO PLUS TABLET
Manage comorbid depression and anxiety disorder
mechanismOfAction:
How SZETALO PLUS TABLET Works

SZETALO PLUS TABLET is a combination of Clonazepam and Escitalopram, where Clonazepam is a benzodiazepine that increases the action of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), a chemical messenger that suppresses the abnormal activity of the nerve cells in the brain. Escitalopram is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) that increases the levels of serotonin, a chemical messenger that improves mood.
usageDetails:
How to use SZETALO PLUS TABLET

Take SZETALO PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medication. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration of SZETALO PLUS TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE 10MG TABLET

ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE 10MG TABLET Works

ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE 10MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
