introduction:
Introduction About NITROSH 10MG TABLET

NITROSH 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITROSH 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITROSH 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITROSH 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITROSH 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITROSH 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITROSH 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITROSH 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITROSH 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITROSH 10MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How NITROSH 10MG TABLET Works

NITROSH 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.

Take NITROSH 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITROSH 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Introduction About MIRAMIND 15MG TABLET

MIRAMIND 15MG TABLET contains Mirtazapine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is used in adults to manage depression. Depression is a mood disorder characterized by persistent feeling of sadness, loss of interest, feeling guilty or worthless, attention impairment, lack of energy, suicidal thoughts and slow or abnormal physical movements.

MIRAMIND 15MG TABLET can be taken with or without meals. It may take around 1-2 weeks for MIRAMIND 15MG TABLET to start working and you may notice improvement in your condition only after 2-4 weeks of therapy. Therefore, take MIRAMIND 15MG TABLET for the duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking MIRAMIND 15MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have jaundice, diabetes, glaucoma, low blood pressure, previous history of fits, suicidal thoughts or other mental illnesses (such as manic depression or schizophrenia) as a precaution.

Avoid concomitant use of MIRAMIND 15MG TABLET with other antidepressants (MAO inhibitor) without consulting your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking MIRAMIND 15MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking MIRAMIND 15MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, weight gain, headache, constipation, dry mouth, problems in sleeping, tremors, anxiety, confusion, joint pain and muscle pain. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if your depression worsens or if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking MIRAMIND 15MG TABLET.

Have suicidal thoughts

introduction:
Introduction About PEDIMAC SYRUP

PEDIMAC SYRUP contains Triclofos which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedative and Hypnotics. It is used for insomnia, recurrent colic with persistent crying, excitability, restlessness and convulsions in children. It is also used to provide sedation (calming down effect) in states of tension and anxiety and before any medical procedure. During management with PEDIMAC SYRUP, your doctor may want to monitor your child’s respiration rate, heart rate, oxygen saturation level in the blood.

PEDIMAC SYRUP is not recommended for use if your child’s is allergic to Triclofos, chloral hydrate or any other ingredients and have porphyria (blood disorder). PEDIMAC SYRUP should be taken with caution since prolonged use of this medicine may cause dependence.

Before giving PEDIMAC SYRUP inform your doctor if your child has any liver, kidney, respiratory and heart diseases to avoid unwanted side effects. The most common side effects of taking PEDIMAC SYRUP includes nausea, vomiting, tiredness, drowsiness, impaired coordination. Consult doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.

It is used in children to manage:

Insomnia
Recurrent colic with persistent crying
Excitability, restlessness
Convulsions
mechanismOfAction:
How PEDIMAC SYRUP Works

PEDIMAC SYRUP contains Triclofos that has sedative and hypnotic effects. It helps to provide adequate sleep and relaxation by suppressing the brain centres that are responsible for keeping awake and anxious.

How to use PEDIMAC SYRUP

Give PEDIMAC SYRUP exactly as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. It can be taken with or without food. Do not stop giving PEDIMAC SYRUP before doctor’s advice. Your doctor will decide the correct duration for your child depending upon the age, body weight and severity of present condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DACTIVE 5MG TABLET

DACTIVE 5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

DACTIVE 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

DACTIVE 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

DACTIVE 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. DACTIVE 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. DACTIVE 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking DACTIVE 5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DACTIVE 5MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How DACTIVE 5MG TABLET Works

DACTIVE 5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use DACTIVE 5MG TABLET

Take DACTIVE 5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CALMTRA 10MG TABLET

CALMTRA 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

CALMTRA 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take CALMTRA 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking CALMTRA 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking CALMTRA 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

CALMTRA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

CALMTRA 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking CALMTRA 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking CALMTRA 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking CALMTRA 10MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALMTRA 10MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)
Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
mechanismOfAction:
How CALMTRA 10MG TABLET Works

CALMTRA 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use CALMTRA 10MG TABLET

introduction:
Introduction About STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET

STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from heart diseases including slow or uneven heartbeat. Consult your doctor before taking STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET.

Mental illness or psychosis or depression

Drug abuse

Fits

Pregnancy

NIDRA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women as it may harm the development of the baby. Such birth defects include cleft lip, cleft palate, reduced foetal movement and foetal heart rate variability, muscle weakness, low body temperature (hypothermia), difficulty feeding and breathing problems (respiratory depression). Consult your doctor before taking NIDRA 10MG TABLET.

Breastfeeding

NIDRA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking NIDRA 10MG TABLET.

Driving and Using Machines

Do not drive or operate any machines if your feel dizzy, drowsy, sleepy, confused, blurring of vision, or less alert after taking NIDRA 10MG TABLET. Consult your doctor for advice.

Alcohol

Do not consume alcohol while taking NIDRA 10MG TABLET as it can cause difficulty in breathing or walking, or put you in a very deep sleep. Consult your doctor before taking NIDRA 10MG TABLET.

Kidney

NIDRA 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking NIDRA 10MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About NAP 5MG TABLET

NAP 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NAP 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NAP 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NAP 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NAP 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NAP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NAP 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NAP 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NAP 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NAP 5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How NAP 5MG TABLET Works

NAP 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NAP 5MG TABLET

Take NAP 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NAP 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Worsening of depression, suicidal thoughts or behavior
Yellowing of skin and whites of the eye (signs of liver problems)
Behavioural changes (such as aggression, excitement, confusion, restlessness, agitation, irritability, rages, hallucinations, nightmares and depression)

Have any psychiatric disorders (such as schizophrenia)
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Have low albumin levels in blood
Have poor blood supply to the brain

NAP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor for advice.

NAP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as it could relax the muscles and increase the risk of fall or injuries in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About CONVACLON 2MG TABLET

CONVACLON 2MG TABLET contains Clonazepam which belongs to the group of medicines known as Benzodiazepines. It is used to manage seizure disorder (epilepsy) in adults and children and panic disorder with or without fear of open spaces (agoraphobia) in adults.

Epilepsy is a common condition affecting the brain and causes frequent fits or seizures (bursts of electrical activity in the brain). Symptoms include uncontrollable jerking or shaking, loss of consciousness or collapse. Panic disorder is characterized by the sudden occurrence of panic attacks or fear.

During the therapy with CONVACLON 2MG TABLET, your doctor may conduct a blood test to determine liver function. Do not consume alcohol while taking CONVACLON 2MG TABLET as it may provoke seizures or fits and may worsen side effects which may possibly lead to severe sedation.

CONVACLON 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with myasthenia gravis, acute narrow-angle glaucoma, sleep apnoea, lung diseases and breathing problems, and severe liver diseases. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CONVACLON 2MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver disease, severe kidney disease, low blood pressure, depression, psychosis and schizophrenia. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CONVACLON 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it. CONVACLON 2MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CONVACLON 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Some severely specific side effects of CONVACLON 2MG TABLET include suicidal thoughts or thoughts of self-harming or unusual changes in behaviour or mood. If you have these thoughts, contact your doctor immediately.

The most common side effects of taking CONVACLON 2MG TABLET are drowsiness, dizziness, problems with walking and coordination, depression, fatigue, and problems with memory. Contact your doctor in case any of the symptoms worsen.

How CONVACLON 2MG TABLET Works

CONVACLON 2MG TABLET belongs to benzodiazepines which work by enhancing the activity of GABA (gamma-aminobutyric acid) an inhibitory neurotransmitter (a chemical in the brain).
usageDetails:
How to use CONVACLON 2MG TABLET

Take CONVACLON 2MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without meals.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet, Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place the medicine inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take this medicine for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About ZLEEP 5MG TABLET

ZLEEP 5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZLEEP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZLEEP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZLEEP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZLEEP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZLEEP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZLEEP 5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

mechanismOfAction:

ZLEEP 5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take ZLEEP 5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NITRAVET 5MG TABLET

NITRAVET 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITRAVET 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITRAVET 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITRAVET 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITRAVET 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET.

How NITRAVET 5MG TABLET Works

NITRAVET 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.

How to use NITRAVET 5MG TABLET

Take NITRAVET 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

INZOFRESH 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

INZOFRESH 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

INZOFRESH 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking INZOFRESH 5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking INZOFRESH 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antipsychotics such as clozapine, haloperidol, and chlorpromazine (medicines used to manage mental illness)
Antidepressants such as sertraline, venlafaxine, fluoxetine, bupropion, and desipramine (medicines used to manage depression)
Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)
Opioids such as codeine, methadone, tramadol, pethidine, oxycodone, and morphine (medicines used for severe pain and cough)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Ketoconazole, and itraconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Overdosage:

If you or anybody else accidentally take too much INZOFRESH 5MG TABLET, consult your doctor or visit the nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of overdose are drowsiness, confusion, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.

name: Zolfresh CR 12.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZOLFRESH CR 12.5MG TABLET

ZOLFRESH CR 12.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLFRESH CR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLFRESH CR 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLFRESH CR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLFRESH CR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLFRESH CR 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLFRESH CR 12.5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOLFRESH CR 12.5MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLFRESH CR 12.5MG TABLET Works

ZOLFRESH CR 12.5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

introduction:
Introduction About NITCALM 10MG TABLET

NITCALM 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITCALM 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITCALM 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITCALM 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITCALM 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITCALM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITCALM 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITCALM 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITCALM 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITCALM 10MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)

Uses Of NITCALM 10MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)

mechanismOfAction:
How NITCALM 10MG TABLET Works

NITCALM 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NITCALM 10MG TABLET

Take NITCALM 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITCALM 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

NITCALM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive and use heavy machinery while taking NITCALM 10MG TABLET as it could reduce alertness and induce drowsiness with poor muscle coordination.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NITCALM 10MG TABLET as it may make you feel dizzier.
NITCALM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

NITCALM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take NITCALM 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Nitrazepam or to any other benzodiazepines (such as clonazepam, diazepam).

NITCALM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe lung diseases (such as COPD). It should be used with caution in patients with mild lung problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
NITCALM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

NITCALM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have any breathing difficulties
Have sleep apnea (breathing difficulties during sleep)
Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness and tenderness)
Have any psychiatric disorders (such as schizophrenia)
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Before taking NITCALM 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are in depression or have a history of depression
Have anxiety or any other mental illnesses
Are alcoholic
Have low albumin levels in blood
Have poor blood supply to the brain
Have epilepsy
Have an history of alcoholism or drug abuse

Use in Pediatrics

NITCALM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics

NITCALM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as it could relax the muscles and increase the risk of fall or injuries in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZAPPY 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZAPPY 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZAPPY 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZAPPY 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZAPPY 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZAPPY 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOPID 5MG TABLET

ZOPID 5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOPID 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOPID 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOPID 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOPID 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOPID 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOPID 5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOPID 5MG TABLET Works

ZOPID 5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take ZOPID 5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NITE 10MG TABLET

NITE 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITE 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITE 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITE 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITE 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITE 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITE 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITE 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITE 10MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITE 10MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)
Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
mechanismOfAction:
How NITE 10MG TABLET Works

NITE 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NITE 10MG TABLET

Take NITE 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITE 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

NITE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as it could relax the muscles and increase the risk of fall or injuries in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET

MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called benzodiazepines (sedatives). MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET is used to management of insomnia (inability to sleep) and to produce sleepiness or drowsiness and to relieve anxiety before a medical test or a procedure. MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET is also used to manage sudden repetitive attacks of fits (epilepsy).

Epilepsy (fits) is a central nervous system (neurological) disorder which affects the brain creating a disturbance in nerve cells and electrical activity leading to sudden, uncontrolled body movements.

Before taking MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have chronic respiratory problems, myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), a history of drug abuse or depression, narrow-angle glaucoma, sleep apnoea syndrome (sleep disorder in which breathing stops and starts repeatedly), kidney, heart, liver problems.

MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET is generally not recommended during pregnancy especially in the last trimester and breastfeeding, unless deemed necessary. MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients, and is contraindicated in children. MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET has a few side effects like nausea, vomiting, headache, drowsiness, runny nose, throat irritation, nasal discomfort, and dizziness in some cases. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: Manage sudden repetitive attacks of fits (epilepsy)

mechanismOfAction:
How MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET Works

MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET contains midazolam which works by increasing a particular chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent (GABA) resulting in sedative, hypnotic (sleep-inducing), anxiolytic (anti-anxiety), anticonvulsant, and muscle relaxant properties. Hence MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET helps manage fits by stabilizing the altered, electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET

Take MEZOLAM 7.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PEDITAG ORAL SOLUTION

PEDITAG ORAL SOLUTION contains Triclofos which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedative and Hypnotics. It is used for insomnia, recurrent colic with persistent crying, excitability, restlessness and convulsions in children. It is also used to provide sedation (calming down effect) in states of tension and anxiety and before any medical procedure. During management with PEDITAG ORAL SOLUTION, your doctor may want to monitor your child’s respiration rate, heart rate, oxygen saturation level in the blood.

PEDITAG ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use if your child’s is allergic to Triclofos, chloral hydrate or any other ingredients and have porphyria (blood disorder). PEDITAG ORAL SOLUTION should be taken with caution since prolonged use of this medicine may cause dependence.

Before giving PEDITAG ORAL SOLUTION inform your doctor if your child has any liver, kidney, respiratory and heart diseases to avoid unwanted side effects. The most common side effects of taking PEDITAG ORAL SOLUTION includes nausea, vomiting, tiredness, drowsiness, impaired coordination. Consult doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.

How PEDITAG ORAL SOLUTION Works

PEDITAG ORAL SOLUTION contains Triclofos that has sedative and hypnotic effects. It helps to provide adequate sleep and relaxation by suppressing the brain centres that are responsible for keeping awake and anxious.

Give PEDITAG ORAL SOLUTION exactly as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. It can be taken with or without food. Do not stop giving PEDITAG ORAL SOLUTION before doctor’s advice. Your doctor will decide the correct duration for your child depending upon the age, body weight and severity of present condition.

introduction:
Introduction About STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET

STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

introduction:
Introduction About NTP 5MG TABLET

NTP 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NTP 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NTP 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NTP 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NTP 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NTP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NTP 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NTP 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NTP 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NTP 5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How NTP 5MG TABLET Works

NTP 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NTP 5MG TABLET

Take NTP 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NTP 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

NIDRA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. NIDRA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. NIDRA 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking NIDRA 5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

mechanismOfAction:

Introduction About ZOLFORD 10 TABLET

ZOLFORD 10 TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLFORD 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLFORD 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLFORD 10 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLFORD 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLFORD 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLFORD 10 TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ZOLFORD 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antipsychotics such as clozapine, haloperidol, and chlorpromazine (medicines used to manage mental illness)
Antidepressants such as sertraline, venlafaxine, fluoxetine, bupropion, and desipramine (medicines used to manage depression)
Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)
Opioids such as codeine, methadone, tramadol, pethidine, oxycodone, and morphine (medicines used for severe pain and cough)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Ketoconazole, and itraconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Overdosage:

If you or anybody else accidentally take too much ZOLFORD 10 TABLET, consult your doctor or visit the nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of overdose are drowsiness, confusion, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.

introduction:
Introduction About MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET

MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET contains Mirtazapine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is used in adults to manage depression. Depression is a mood disorder characterized by persistent feeling of sadness, loss of interest, feeling guilty or worthless, attention impairment, lack of energy, suicidal thoughts and slow or abnormal physical movements.

MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET can be taken with or without meals. It may take around 1-2 weeks for MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET to start working and you may notice improvement in your condition only after 2-4 weeks of therapy. Therefore, take MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET for the duration recommended by your doctor to achieve better results.

Before taking MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have jaundice, diabetes, glaucoma, low blood pressure, previous history of fits, suicidal thoughts or other mental illnesses (such as manic depression or schizophrenia) as a precaution.

Avoid concomitant use of MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET with other antidepressants (MAO inhibitor) without consulting your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, weight gain, headache, constipation, dry mouth, problems in sleeping, tremors, anxiety, confusion, joint pain and muscle pain. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if your depression worsens or if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET
Manage depression in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET Works

MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET is an antidepressant medication. It acts by increasing the levels of certain chemical messengers (such as serotonin and norepinephrine) in the brain that can stabilize mood and mental health. As a result, it improves your mood and energy and reduce the signs of depression.
usageDetails:
How to use MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET

Take MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablets: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablets: Disperse the medicine in the required amount of water as mentioned in the product label. Consume the mixture immediately after dispersion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking MIRAMIND 30MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may make your symptoms re-appear once again or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as vomiting, dizziness, agitation, anxiety or headaches.

Introduction About NITAB 20MG TABLET

NITAB 20MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITAB 20MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITAB 20MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITAB 20MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITAB 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITAB 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITAB 20MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITAB 20MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITAB 20MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITAB 20MG TABLET.

Kidney

Liver

NITAB 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About AMBIZ TABLET

AMBIZ TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

AMBIZ TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

AMBIZ TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

AMBIZ TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. AMBIZ TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. AMBIZ TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking AMBIZ TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How AMBIZ TABLET Works

AMBIZ TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take AMBIZ TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

AMBIZ TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking AMBIZ TABLET.
AMBIZ TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking AMBIZ TABLET.
Do not take AMBIZ TABLET if you are allergic to Zopiclone or lactose or other lactose other ingredients in the medicine.

AMBIZ TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients with severe respiratory disorders or breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor before taking AMBIZ TABLET.
AMBIZ TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from heart diseases including slow or uneven heartbeat. Consult your doctor before taking AMBIZ TABLET.

Others

AMBIZ TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Mental illness or psychosis or depression

Before taking AMBIZ TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Depression and any other mental illness
Drug abuse
Plans to take a blood test to check liver function
Thoughts of harming or killing yourself
Fits

Use in paediatrics:

AMBIZ TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking AMBIZ TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

AMBIZ TABLET should be used with caution in patients more than 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking AMBIZ TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About MIDFAST 5MG INJECTION

MIDFAST 5MG INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MIDFAST 5MG INJECTION. Do not receive MIDFAST 5MG INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MIDFAST 5MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MIDFAST 5MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MIDFAST 5MG INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How MIDFAST 5MG INJECTION Works

MIDFAST 5MG INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MIDFAST 5MG INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

MIDFAST 5MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Nitab 5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NITAB 5MG TABLET

NITAB 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITAB 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITAB 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITAB 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITAB 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITAB 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITAB 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITAB 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITAB 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITAB 5MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITAB 5MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)
Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
mechanismOfAction:
How NITAB 5MG TABLET Works

NITAB 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NITAB 5MG TABLET

Take NITAB 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITAB 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Do not drive and use heavy machinery while taking NITAB 5MG TABLET as it could reduce alertness and induce drowsiness with poor muscle coordination.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NITAB 5MG TABLET as it may make you feel dizzier.
NITAB 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

NITAB 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take NITAB 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Nitrazepam or to any other benzodiazepines (such as clonazepam, diazepam).

NITAB 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe lung diseases (such as COPD). It should be used with caution in patients with mild lung problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
NITAB 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

NITAB 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have any breathing difficulties
Have sleep apnea (breathing difficulties during sleep)
Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness and tenderness)
Have any psychiatric disorders (such as schizophrenia)
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Before taking NITAB 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are in depression or have a history of depression
Have anxiety or any other mental illnesses
Are alcoholic
Have low albumin levels in blood
Have poor blood supply to the brain
Have epilepsy
Have an history of alcoholism or drug abuse

Use in Pediatrics

NITAB 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics

NITAB 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as it could relax the muscles and increase the risk of fall or injuries in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions

Anaesthetics (used to cause numbness of body parts or loss of consciousness) Ex. lignocaine, sevoflurane
Antihistamines (used to manage allergic symptoms) Ex. cetirizine

Nabilone (a medicine used to manage nausea and vomiting)
Opioid analgesics (used for pain relief) such as morphine, fentanyl, pethidine

Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Moxonidine (a medicine used to reduce high blood pressure)
Muscle relaxants (used to reduce muscle spasms) Ex. baclofen, tizanidine
Erythromycin (a medicine used to manage bacterial infections)
Cimetidine (a medicine used to manage stomach ulcers)

If you or anyone else accidentally took more NITAB 5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. name: Etirest 0.25mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET

ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET contains Etizolam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is used in the management of short-term anxiety. Anxiety is a mental health disease characterized by fear, worry, and excessive nervousness.

ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET is also used to manage insomnia. Insomnia is a sleep disease that causes trouble in falling asleep or staying asleep.

ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET can have a serious side effect like suicidal thoughts, consult your doctor immediately if you have suicidal or aggressive thoughts.

ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease, lung diseases, myasthenia gravis, acute narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye), chronic psychosis, or porphyria.

Before taking ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, alcohol addiction, or personality disorders. ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET can be used in children and adolescents. However, consult with your child’s doctor before giving it to your child.

In elderly patients, ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution. The most common side effects of taking ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET are decreased heart rate, impaired coordination, sleepiness, yawning, decreased appetite, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth and headache. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET

Manage:

Short-term anxiety
Insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET Works

ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET work by increasing the activity of GABA (a chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent) and inducing sleep. Thereby, relaxes muscles, reduces anxiety, and helps to fall asleep.
usageDetails:
How to use ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET

Take ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Take this medicine with or without meals.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet, Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET as it can worsen the side effects.
ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having kidney diseases such as impaired kidney function. Consult your doctor before taking it.

ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease such as severe hepatic impairment and should be used with caution in patients having impaired liver function. Consult your doctor before taking ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET.
Do not take ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET if you are allergic to Etizolam or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as respiratory depression or acute pulmonary insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients having chronic pulmonary insufficiency. Consult your doctor before taking ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET.

Others

ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Acute narrow-angle glaucoma
Myasthenia gravis
Coma
Sleep apnea syndrome
Chronic psychosis
Depression or anxiety associated with depression
Phobic or obsessional states
Porphyria

Before taking ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Muscle weakness
Alcohol or drug addiction
Personality disorders
Organic brain changes (disturbances in cognitive functions such as thinking, memory, perception, attention)

Use in pediatrics:

ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET can be used in children and adolescents. However, consult with your child’s doctor before giving ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

ETIREST 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET

NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)
Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
mechanismOfAction:
How NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET Works

NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET

Take NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
