Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET as it may make you feel dizzier.
NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Nitrazepam or to any other benzodiazepines (such as clonazepam, diazepam).

NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe lung diseases (such as COPD). It should be used with caution in patients with mild lung problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have any breathing difficulties
Have sleep apnea (breathing difficulties during sleep)
Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness and tenderness)
Have any psychiatric disorders (such as schizophrenia)
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Before taking NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are in depression or have a history of depression
Have anxiety or any other mental illnesses
Are alcoholic
Have low albumin levels in blood
Have poor blood supply to the brain
Have epilepsy
Have an history of alcoholism or drug abuse

Use in Pediatrics

NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics

NITRAZ SR 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as it could relax the muscles and increase the risk of fall or injuries in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

name: Zopid 10mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZOPID 10MG TABLET

ZOPID 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOPID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOPID 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOPID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOPID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOPID 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOPID 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOPID 10MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOPID 10MG TABLET Works

ZOPID 10MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOPID 10MG TABLET

Take ZOPID 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Such birth defects include cleft lip, cleft palate, reduced foetal movement and foetal heart rate variability, muscle weakness, low body temperature (hypothermia), difficulty feeding and breathing problems (respiratory depression). ZOPID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking ZOPID 10MG TABLET.

Do not consume alcohol while taking ZOPID 10MG TABLET as it can cause difficulty in breathing or walking, or put you in a very deep sleep. Consult your doctor before taking ZOPID 10MG TABLET.
ZOPID 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking ZOPID 10MG TABLET.
ZOPID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking ZOPID 10MG TABLET.
Do not take ZOPID 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Zopiclone or lactose or other lactose other ingredients in the medicine.

ZOPID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients with severe respiratory disorders or breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor before taking ZOPID 10MG TABLET.
ZOPID 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from heart diseases including slow or uneven heartbeat. Consult your doctor before taking ZOPID 10MG TABLET.

Others

ZOPID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Mental illness or psychosis or depression

Before taking ZOPID 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Depression and any other mental illness
Drug abuse
Plans to take a blood test to check liver function
Thoughts of harming or killing yourself
Fits

ZOPID 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking ZOPID 10MG TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

ZOPID 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients more than 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking ZOPID 10MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About NITHRA 10MG TABLET

NITHRA 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITHRA 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITHRA 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITHRA 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITHRA 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITHRA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITHRA 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITHRA 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITHRA 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITHRA 10MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)

mechanismOfAction:
How NITHRA 10MG TABLET Works

NITHRA 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NITHRA 10MG TABLET

Take NITHRA 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITHRA 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

name: ZOPIREST 7.5mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET contains Zopiclone which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics and Sedatives. It is indicated for the short-term management and symptomatic relief of insomnia characterized by difficulty in falling asleep, frequent nocturnal awakenings and or early morning awakenings.

Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep. You may still feel tired when you wake up. It also affects your health, work performance and quality of life.

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping) and in patients who had stroke. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from depression or any other mental illness, personality disorder, kidney disease, somnambulism (sleep walking), thyroid disorder, epilepsy (seizures). Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET are dry mouth, bitter or metallic taste, feeling sleepy or drowsy, headache and fatigue, dizziness, lightheadedness and difficulty with coordination. Contact your doctor if you get any side effects. Specific serious side effects include suicidal thoughts in some patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience such thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET
Manage insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET Works

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET helps to improve your sleep by binding to benzodiazepine receptors in brain and increases the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA (a neurotransmitter helps to transfer messages in the brain) and produces a calming effect on the brain. Thus, helps to manage sleep disorders.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET

Take ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause harm to the unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking.
ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass into the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking.
ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET may cause drowsiness which can affect your ability to drive and operate machines. Do not drive or operate machines after taking ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET.

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have history of alcohol abuse. Consumption of alcohol is not advised while taking this medicine as it increases sleepiness. Consult your doctor before taking.
ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver diseases. Consult your doctor before taking.
Do not take ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Zopiclone or to other ingredients of medicine.

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients suffering from severe respiratory disorders. Consult your doctor before taking.

Others

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Had stroke
Ever experienced sleepwalking or other unusual behaviour while not being fully awake after taking ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET

Before taking ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have:

Personality disorder
Depression and any other mental illness such as psychoses, schizophrenia
A history of drug abuse
Periodic limb movement disorder (involuntary moving the limbs in sleep)
Restless legs syndrome (an urge to move legs constantly)
Surgery or anaesthesia
Somnambulism (sleep walking)
Thyroid disorder
Epilepsy (seizures)

Use in paediatrics:

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

Use in geriatrics:

ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as they are more susceptible to the sedative effects of this medicine associated with giddiness, ataxia and confusion, which may increase the possibility of a fall. Consult your doctor before taking.

Overdosage:

If you or anybody else accidently takes too much ZOPIREST 7.5MG TABLET, consult your nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of mild overdosage are drowsiness, dizziness, lightheaded or faint, falling over or losing your balance, confusion, lethargy, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.

Symptoms of severe overdosage are low blood pressure, respiratory disorder or shallow breathing or difficulty breathing, weak muscle tone, methemoglobinemia (increased methaemoglobin in blood), ataxia (impaired coordination). Consult your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET

NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET Works

NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET

Take NITREST CR 6.25MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET

MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET contains Etizolam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is used in the management of short-term anxiety. Anxiety is a mental health disease characterized by fear, worry, and excessive nervousness.

MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET is also used to manage insomnia. Insomnia is a sleep disease that causes trouble in falling asleep or staying asleep.

MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET can have a serious side effect like suicidal thoughts, consult your doctor immediately if you have suicidal or aggressive thoughts.

MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease, lung diseases, myasthenia gravis, acute narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye), chronic psychosis, or porphyria.

Before taking MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, alcohol addiction, or personality disorders. MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET can be used in children and adolescents. However, consult with your child’s doctor before giving it to your child.

In elderly patients, MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET should be used with caution. The most common side effects of taking MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET are decreased heart rate, impaired coordination, sleepiness, yawning, decreased appetite, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth and headache. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
usesDetails:

Manage:

Short-term anxiety
Insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET Works

MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET work by increasing the activity of GABA (a chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent) and inducing sleep. Thereby, relaxes muscles, reduces anxiety, and helps to fall asleep.
usageDetails:
How to use MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET

Take MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Take this medicine with or without meals.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet, Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take MACZOLAM 0.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: SEDEVEN 5mg Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION

SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION. Do not receive SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults

It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION
It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults
It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults
mechanismOfAction:
How SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION Works

SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.
usageDetails:
How to use SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION

SEDEVEN 5MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ZOPENTA 7.5MG TABLET

ZOPENTA 7.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOPENTA 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOPENTA 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOPENTA 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOPENTA 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOPENTA 7.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOPENTA 7.5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZOPENTA 7.5MG TABLET Works

ZOPENTA 7.5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take ZOPENTA 7.5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRINIT 5 TABLET

TRINIT 5 TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

TRINIT 5 TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take TRINIT 5 TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking TRINIT 5 TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking TRINIT 5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

TRINIT 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

TRINIT 5 TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking TRINIT 5 TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking TRINIT 5 TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking TRINIT 5 TABLET.

How TRINIT 5 TABLET Works

TRINIT 5 TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.

Take TRINIT 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking TRINIT 5 TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

introduction:
Introduction About MEZOLAM INJECTION

MEZOLAM INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MEZOLAM INJECTION. Do not receive MEZOLAM INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MEZOLAM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MEZOLAM INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MEZOLAM INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults

It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults

mechanismOfAction:
How MEZOLAM INJECTION Works

MEZOLAM INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MEZOLAM INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.
usageDetails:
How to use MEZOLAM INJECTION

MEZOLAM INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About N TRA 10MG TABLET

N TRA 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

N TRA 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take N TRA 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking N TRA 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking N TRA 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

N TRA 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

N TRA 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking N TRA 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking N TRA 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking N TRA 10MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How N TRA 10MG TABLET Works

N TRA 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use N TRA 10MG TABLET

Take N TRA 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking N TRA 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

introduction:
Introduction About SYLKAM 1MG TABLET

SYLKAM 1MG TABLET contains Etizolam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is used in the management of short-term anxiety. Anxiety is a mental health disease characterized by fear, worry, and excessive nervousness.

SYLKAM 1MG TABLET is also used to manage insomnia. Insomnia is a sleep disease that causes trouble in falling asleep or staying asleep.

SYLKAM 1MG TABLET can have a serious side effect like suicidal thoughts, consult your doctor immediately if you have suicidal or aggressive thoughts.

SYLKAM 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease, lung diseases, myasthenia gravis, acute narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye), chronic psychosis, or porphyria.

Before taking SYLKAM 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, alcohol addiction, or personality disorders. SYLKAM 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. SYLKAM 1MG TABLET can be used in children and adolescents. However, consult with your child’s doctor before giving it to your child.

In elderly patients, SYLKAM 1MG TABLET should be used with caution. The most common side effects of taking SYLKAM 1MG TABLET are decreased heart rate, impaired coordination, sleepiness, yawning, decreased appetite, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth and headache. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYLKAM 1MG TABLET

Manage:

Short-term anxiety
Insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How SYLKAM 1MG TABLET Works

SYLKAM 1MG TABLET work by increasing the activity of GABA (a chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent) and inducing sleep. Thereby, relaxes muscles, reduces anxiety, and helps to fall asleep.
usageDetails:
How to use SYLKAM 1MG TABLET

Take SYLKAM 1MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Take this medicine with or without meals.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow SYLKAM 1MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet, Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place SYLKAM 1MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take SYLKAM 1MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLPINITE 10MG TABLET

ZOLPINITE 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLPINITE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLPINITE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLPINITE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLPINITE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLPINITE 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLPINITE 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

ZOLPINITE 10MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

name: Calmtra 5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CALMTRA 5MG TABLET

CALMTRA 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

CALMTRA 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take CALMTRA 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking CALMTRA 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking CALMTRA 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

CALMTRA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

CALMTRA 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking CALMTRA 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking CALMTRA 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking CALMTRA 5MG TABLET.

usesDetails:
Uses Of CALMTRA 5MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)
Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
mechanismOfAction:
How CALMTRA 5MG TABLET Works

CALMTRA 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use CALMTRA 5MG TABLET

Take CALMTRA 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking CALMTRA 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Worsening of depression, suicidal thoughts or behavior
Yellowing of skin and whites of the eye (signs of liver problems)
Behavioural changes (such as aggression, excitement, confusion, restlessness, agitation, irritability, rages, hallucinations, nightmares and depression)

CALMTRA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive and use heavy machinery while taking CALMTRA 5MG TABLET as it could reduce alertness and induce drowsiness with poor muscle coordination.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CALMTRA 5MG TABLET as it may make you feel dizzier.
CALMTRA 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

CALMTRA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CALMTRA 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Nitrazepam or to any other benzodiazepines (such as clonazepam, diazepam).

CALMTRA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe lung diseases (such as COPD). It should be used with caution in patients with mild lung problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CALMTRA 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

CALMTRA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have any breathing difficulties
Have sleep apnea (breathing difficulties during sleep)
Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness and tenderness)
Have any psychiatric disorders (such as schizophrenia)
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Before taking CALMTRA 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are in depression or have a history of depression
Have anxiety or any other mental illnesses
Are alcoholic
Have low albumin levels in blood
Have poor blood supply to the brain
Have epilepsy
Have an history of alcoholism or drug abuse

Use in Pediatrics

CALMTRA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics

CALMTRA 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as it could relax the muscles and increase the risk of fall or injuries in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions

Before taking CALMTRA 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage depress brain such as antidepressants (Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline), hypnotics (Ex. alprazolam, midazolam), neuroleptics (Ex. haloperidol)
Anaesthetics (used to cause numbness of body parts or loss of consciousness) Ex. lignocaine, sevoflurane
Antihistamines (used to manage allergic symptoms) Ex. cetirizine
Lofexidine (a medicine used to manage withdrawal symptoms of opioids)
Nabilone (a medicine used to manage nausea and vomiting)
Opioid analgesics (used for pain relief) such as morphine, fentanyl, pethidine
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin and phenobarbital)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Moxonidine (a medicine used to reduce high blood pressure)
Muscle relaxants (used to reduce muscle spasms) Ex. baclofen, tizanidine
Erythromycin (a medicine used to manage bacterial infections)
Cimetidine (a medicine used to manage stomach ulcers)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more CALMTRA 5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose might include drowsiness, confusion, muscle relaxation, lack of coordination, decreased blood pressure, and extremely slow and/or shallow breathing and pulse.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXMEDINE INJECTION

DEXMEDINE INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

DEXMEDINE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXMEDINE INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXMEDINE INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXMEDINE INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXMEDINE INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
usesDetails:
Uses Of DEXMEDINE INJECTION
To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
mechanismOfAction:
How DEXMEDINE INJECTION Works

DEXMEDINE INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use DEXMEDINE INJECTION

DEXMEDINE INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.

Ask your doctor when you can start doing these activities again and when you can go back to this kind of work.

DEXMEDINE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders (heart block grade 2 or 3), very low blood pressure which does not respond to> management. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

Recently had a stroke or other serious condition affecting blood supply to the brain

DEXMEDINE INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years due to increased risk of low heart rate and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

name: Zolinox Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZOLINOX TABLET

ZOLINOX TABLET contains Zopiclone which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics and Sedatives. It is indicated for the short-term management and symptomatic relief of insomnia characterized by difficulty in falling asleep, frequent nocturnal awakenings and or early morning awakenings.

Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep. You may still feel tired when you wake up. It also affects your health, work performance and quality of life.

ZOLINOX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping) and in patients who had stroke. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOLINOX TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from depression or any other mental illness, personality disorder, kidney disease, somnambulism (sleep walking), thyroid disorder, epilepsy (seizures). Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOLINOX TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZOLINOX TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOLINOX TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ZOLINOX TABLET are dry mouth, bitter or metallic taste, feeling sleepy or drowsy, headache and fatigue, dizziness, lightheadedness and difficulty with coordination. Contact your doctor if you get any side effects. Specific serious side effects include suicidal thoughts in some patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience such thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOLINOX TABLET
Manage insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLINOX TABLET Works

ZOLINOX TABLET helps to improve your sleep by binding to benzodiazepine receptors in brain and increases the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA (a neurotransmitter helps to transfer messages in the brain) and produces a calming effect on the brain. Thus, helps to manage sleep disorders.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOLINOX TABLET

Take ZOLINOX TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

ZOLINOX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver diseases. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOLINOX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients suffering from severe respiratory disorders. Consult your doctor before taking.

Had stroke

Personality disorder

A history of drug abuse

ZOLINOX TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as they are more susceptible to the sedative effects of this medicine associated with giddiness, ataxia and confusion, which may increase the possibility of a fall. Consult your doctor before taking.

introduction:
Introduction About SEDOZ INJECTION

SEDOZ INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

introduction:
Introduction About SOZA 5MG TABLET

SOZA 5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

SOZA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

SOZA 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

SOZA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. SOZA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. SOZA 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking SOZA 5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SOZA 5MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How SOZA 5MG TABLET Works

SOZA 5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:

Take SOZA 5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET

SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET contains Etizolam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is used in the management of short-term anxiety. Anxiety is a mental health disease characterized by fear, worry, and excessive nervousness.

SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET is also used to manage insomnia. Insomnia is a sleep disease that causes trouble in falling asleep or staying asleep.

SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET can have a serious side effect like suicidal thoughts, consult your doctor immediately if you have suicidal or aggressive thoughts.

SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease, lung diseases, myasthenia gravis, acute narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye), chronic psychosis, or porphyria.

Before taking SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, alcohol addiction, or personality disorders. SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET can be used in children and adolescents. However, consult with your child’s doctor before giving it to your child.

In elderly patients, SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET should be used with caution. The most common side effects of taking SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET are decreased heart rate, impaired coordination, sleepiness, yawning, decreased appetite, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth and headache. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET

Manage:

Short-term anxiety
Insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET Works

SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET work by increasing the activity of GABA (a chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent) and inducing sleep. Thereby, relaxes muscles, reduces anxiety, and helps to fall asleep.
usageDetails:
How to use SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET

Take SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Take this medicine with or without meals.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet, Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take SYLKAM 1MG 1MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Introduction About ZOLPIREST 5MG TABLET

ZOLPIREST 5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLPIREST 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLPIREST 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLPIREST 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLPIREST 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLPIREST 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLPIREST 5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

ZOLPIREST 5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

introduction:
Introduction About DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET

DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET Works

DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antidepressants such as sertraline, venlafaxine, fluoxetine, bupropion, and desipramine (medicines used to manage depression)
Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)
Opioids such as codeine, methadone, tramadol, pethidine, oxycodone, and morphine (medicines used for severe pain and cough)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Ketoconazole, and itraconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Overdosage:

If you or anybody else accidentally take too much DACTIVE SR 6.25MG TABLET, consult your doctor or visit the nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of overdose are drowsiness, confusion, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.

Before taking ZOLWAY 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc

introduction:
Introduction About SEDEVEN INJECTION

SEDEVEN INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving SEDEVEN INJECTION. Do not receive SEDEVEN INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving SEDEVEN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

SEDEVEN INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. SEDEVEN INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How SEDEVEN INJECTION Works

SEDEVEN INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, SEDEVEN INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

How to use SEDEVEN INJECTION

SEDEVEN INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About N TRA 5MG TABLET

N TRA 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

N TRA 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take N TRA 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking N TRA 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking N TRA 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

N TRA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

N TRA 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking N TRA 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking N TRA 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking N TRA 5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How N TRA 5MG TABLET Works

N TRA 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use N TRA 5MG TABLET

Take N TRA 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking N TRA 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NIRA 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NIRA 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NIRA 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NIRA 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NIRA 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NIRA 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NIRA 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NIRA 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:

Take ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antipsychotics such as clozapine, haloperidol, and chlorpromazine (medicines used to manage mental illness)
Antidepressants such as sertraline, venlafaxine, fluoxetine, bupropion, and desipramine (medicines used to manage depression)
Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)
Opioids such as codeine, methadone, tramadol, pethidine, oxycodone, and morphine (medicines used for severe pain and cough)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Ketoconazole, and itraconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Overdosage:

If you or anybody else accidentally take too much ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET, consult your doctor or visit the nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of overdose are drowsiness, confusion, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET

ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLDEM 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

introduction:
Introduction About MEDZOL INJECTION

MEDZOL INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MEDZOL INJECTION. Do not receive MEDZOL INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MEDZOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MEDZOL INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MEDZOL INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults

It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults

mechanismOfAction:
How MEDZOL INJECTION Works

MEDZOL INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MEDZOL INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.
usageDetails:
How to use MEDZOL INJECTION

MEDZOL INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

MEDZOL INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Do not breastfeed for 24 hours after receiving MEDZOL INJECTION. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, sleepy forgetful or impaired concentration and coordination after receiving MEDZOL INJECTION.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving MEDZOL INJECTION because it may make you feel very sleepy and cause breathing problems.
MEDZOL INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MEDZOL INJECTION.
MEDZOL INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MEDZOL INJECTION.
Do not receive MEDZOL INJECTION if you are allergic to midazolam or other benzodiazepine medicines, such as diazepam or nitrazepam.
MEDZOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe breathing problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MEDZOL INJECTION.
MEDZOL INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MEDZOL INJECTION.

Others

Before receiving MEDZOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have an illness that makes you feel very weak, run down and short of energy
Have myasthenia gravis
Have sleep apnoea syndrome
Have ever had alcohol or drug problems

Use in paediatrics:

MEDZOL INJECTION should be cautious in infants, children and adolescents (less than 6 months to 16 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in geriatrics:

MEDZOL INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly (60 years and above) patients because there is an increased risk of fall, fractures and life-threatening side effects. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLDY 5MG TABLET

ZOLDY 5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLDY 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLDY 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLDY 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLDY 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLDY 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLDY 5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOLDY 5MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLDY 5MG TABLET Works

ZOLDY 5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOLDY 5MG TABLET

Take ZOLDY 5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

Myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Mental illness or psychosis or depression

Depression and any other mental illness
Drug abuse
Plans to take a blood test to check liver function
Thoughts of harming or killing yourself
