introduction:
Introduction About NITE 5MG TABLET

NITE 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITE 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITE 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITE 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITE 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITE 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITE 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITE 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITE 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITE 5MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)

mechanismOfAction:
How NITE 5MG TABLET Works

NITE 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.

Take NITE 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITE 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Do not drive and use heavy machinery while taking NITE 5MG TABLET as it could reduce alertness and induce drowsiness with poor muscle coordination.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NITE 5MG TABLET as it may make you feel dizzier.
NITE 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

NITE 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take NITE 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Nitrazepam or to any other benzodiazepines (such as clonazepam, diazepam).

NITE 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe lung diseases (such as COPD). It should be used with caution in patients with mild lung problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
NITE 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

NITE 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have any breathing difficulties
Have sleep apnea (breathing difficulties during sleep)
Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness and tenderness)
Have any psychiatric disorders (such as schizophrenia)
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Before taking NITE 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are in depression or have a history of depression
Have anxiety or any other mental illnesses
Are alcoholic
Have low albumin levels in blood
Have poor blood supply to the brain
Have epilepsy
Have an history of alcoholism or drug abuse

Use in Pediatrics

NITE 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics

NITE 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as it could relax the muscles and increase the risk of fall or injuries in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions

Before taking NITE 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage depress brain such as antidepressants (Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline), hypnotics (Ex. alprazolam, midazolam), neuroleptics (Ex. haloperidol)
Anaesthetics (used to cause numbness of body parts or loss of consciousness) Ex. lignocaine, sevoflurane

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET

ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET Works

ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET

Take ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if your feel dizzy, drowsy, sleepy, confused, blurring of vision, or less alert after taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not consume alcohol while taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET as it can cause difficulty in breathing or walking, or put you in a very deep sleep. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET.
ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET.
ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET.
Do not take ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Zopiclone or lactose or other lactose other ingredients in the medicine.

ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients with severe respiratory disorders or breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET.
ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from heart diseases including slow or uneven heartbeat. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET.

Others

ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Mental illness or psychosis or depression

Before taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Depression and any other mental illness
Drug abuse
Plans to take a blood test to check liver function
Thoughts of harming or killing yourself
Fits

Use in paediatrics:

ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients more than 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antipsychotics such as clozapine, haloperidol, and chlorpromazine (medicines used to manage mental illness)
Antidepressants such as sertraline, venlafaxine, fluoxetine, bupropion, and desipramine (medicines used to manage depression)
Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)
Opioids such as codeine, methadone, tramadol, pethidine, oxycodone, and morphine (medicines used for severe pain and cough)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Ketoconazole, and itraconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Overdosage:

If you or anybody else accidentally take too much ZOLIDAC 10MG TABLET, consult your doctor or visit the nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of overdose are drowsiness, confusion, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.

introduction:
Introduction About ZECLONE TABLET

ZECLONE TABLET contains Zopiclone which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics and Sedatives. It is indicated for the short-term management and symptomatic relief of insomnia characterized by difficulty in falling asleep, frequent nocturnal awakenings and or early morning awakenings.

Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep. You may still feel tired when you wake up. It also affects your health, work performance and quality of life.

ZECLONE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping) and in patients who had stroke. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZECLONE TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from depression or any other mental illness, personality disorder, kidney disease, somnambulism (sleep walking), thyroid disorder, epilepsy (seizures). Consult your doctor before taking.

ZECLONE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZECLONE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZECLONE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ZECLONE TABLET are dry mouth, bitter or metallic taste, feeling sleepy or drowsy, headache and fatigue, dizziness, lightheadedness and difficulty with coordination. Contact your doctor if you get any side effects. Specific serious side effects include suicidal thoughts in some patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience such thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZECLONE TABLET
Manage insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How ZECLONE TABLET Works

ZECLONE TABLET helps to improve your sleep by binding to benzodiazepine receptors in brain and increases the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA (a neurotransmitter helps to transfer messages in the brain) and produces a calming effect on the brain. Thus, helps to manage sleep disorders.
usageDetails:
How to use ZECLONE TABLET

Take ZECLONE TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: ZECLONE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause harm to the unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking.
ZECLONE TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass into the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking.
ZECLONE TABLET may cause drowsiness which can affect your ability to drive and operate machines. Do not drive or operate machines after taking ZECLONE TABLET.

ZECLONE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have history of alcohol abuse. Consumption of alcohol is not advised while taking this medicine as it increases sleepiness. Consult your doctor before taking.
ZECLONE TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking.
ZECLONE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver diseases. Consult your doctor before taking.
Do not take ZECLONE TABLET if you are allergic to Zopiclone or to other ingredients of medicine.

ZECLONE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients suffering from severe respiratory disorders. Consult your doctor before taking.

Others

ZECLONE TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Had stroke
Ever experienced sleepwalking or other unusual behaviour while not being fully awake after taking ZECLONE TABLET

Before taking ZECLONE TABLET inform your doctor if you have:

Personality disorder
Depression and any other mental illness such as psychoses, schizophrenia
A history of drug abuse
Periodic limb movement disorder (involuntary moving the limbs in sleep)
Restless legs syndrome (an urge to move legs constantly)
Surgery or anaesthesia
Somnambulism (sleep walking)
Thyroid disorder
Epilepsy (seizures)

Use in paediatrics:

ZECLONE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

Use in geriatrics:

ZECLONE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as they are more susceptible to the sedative effects of this medicine associated with giddiness, ataxia and confusion, which may increase the possibility of a fall. Consult your doctor before taking.

Introduction About ADSLEEP 5 TABLET

ADSLEEP 5 TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ADSLEEP 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ADSLEEP 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ADSLEEP 5 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ADSLEEP 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ADSLEEP 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ADSLEEP 5 TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

name: Fenobarb 60mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FENOBARB 60MG TABLET

FENOBARB 60MG TABLET contains Phenobarbitone which belongs to the group of medicines called Barbiturates. It is used in the management of epilepsy to reduce the number and severity of fits. It is used to manage all forms of epilepsy except absence seizures (also called petit mal seizures in children).

Epilepsy is a chronic disease of the brain characterized by repeated seizures (brief episodes of involuntary movement that may involve a part of the body (partial) or the entire body (generalized) accompanied by loss of consciousness and bladder or bowel function).

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking FENOBARB 60MG TABLET as it interferes with the action of this medicine. FENOBARB 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with porphyria, addison’s disease, breathing problems, kidney and liver problems.

FENOBARB 60MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if clearly advised by the doctor. FENOBARB 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

FENOBARB 60MG TABLET should be used with caution in children. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Specific serious side effects include thoughts of harming or killing yourself, consult your physician immediately if you experience any such side effects. The side effect of taking FENOBARB 60MG TABLET include drowsiness. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FENOBARB 60MG TABLET
Manage epilepsy
mechanismOfAction:
How FENOBARB 60MG TABLET Works

FENOBARB 60MG TABLET works by acting on the GABA-A receptors and increases the activity of GABA, a natural chemical messenger helps to suppress the abnormal activity of nerve cells triggering seizures. Thus, helps to manage seizures effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use FENOBARB 60MG TABLET

Take FENOBARB 60MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Dose and duration will be decided by your physician depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking FENOBARB 60MG TABLET without consulting your doctor. Sudden cessation of this medicine may develop withdrawal effects such as sleeplessness, anxiety, tremor, dizziness, headache, nausea, fits and delirium.
sideEffects: Paradoxical CNS reactions (hyperactivity, anxiety in children)

FENOBARB 60MG TABLET should be used with caution in children. Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose based on child’s body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
FENOBARB 60MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

FENOBARB 60MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Porphyria (a genetic or inherited disorder which affects the skin or nervous system)
Addison’s Disease (condition affecting the adrenal glands)

Have a history of alcohol or drug addiction
Have severe or long-term pain
Need to take blood or urine test
Intolerance to some sugars

introduction:
Introduction About DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET

DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET Works

DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:

Take DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: DEXIT 50mg Injection 0.5ml
introduction:
Introduction About DEXIT 50MG INJECTION

DEXIT 50MG INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

DEXIT 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXIT 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXIT 50MG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXIT 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXIT 50MG INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
usesDetails:
Uses Of DEXIT 50MG INJECTION
To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
mechanismOfAction:
How DEXIT 50MG INJECTION Works

DEXIT 50MG INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use DEXIT 50MG INJECTION

DEXIT 50MG INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About MEZOLAM 5MG INJECTION

MEZOLAM 5MG INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MEZOLAM 5MG INJECTION. Do not receive MEZOLAM 5MG INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MEZOLAM 5MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MEZOLAM 5MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MEZOLAM 5MG INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEZOLAM 5MG INJECTION Works

MEZOLAM 5MG INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MEZOLAM 5MG INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

MEZOLAM 5MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Nitravet 2.5mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET

NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)

mechanismOfAction:
How NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET Works

NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET

Take NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITRAVET 2.5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION. Do not receive MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

How MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION Works

MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe breathing problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION.
MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION.

Others

Before receiving MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have an illness that makes you feel very weak, run down and short of energy
Have myasthenia gravis
Have sleep apnoea syndrome
Have ever had alcohol or drug problems

MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION should be cautious in infants, children and adolescents (less than 6 months to 16 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in geriatrics:

MIDFAST 10MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly (60 years and above) patients because there is an increased risk of fall, fractures and life-threatening side effects. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET

SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLETcontains a combination of Clonazepam and Escitalopram which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is indicated for the management of comorbid depression and anxiety disorder.

Comorbid depression and anxiety disorder is condition in which the person has anxiety and depression together at the same time. Symptoms are persistent feeling of sadness or loss of interest, changes in sleep, appetite, energy level, concentration or daily behavior, feeling nervous or restless, fast heartrate, heavy breathing.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET. SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET is not recommended to use in patients having liver or heart diseases, acute narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure within the eye) or if you are taking MAO inhibitors such as isocarboxazid or moclobemide (to manage depression), selegiline (used to manage Parkinson’s disease) or linezolid (an antibiotic).

Before taking SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver or, lung diseases, epilepsy, low levels of sodium, tendency of bleeding and bruising and diabetes. Patients should be monitored for signs of suicidal ideation and behaviors and advised to seek immediate medical advice if any such signs occur.

SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking it. SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (18 years and below).SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhea, constipation, dry mouth, increased sweating, increased or decreased appetite, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists.
uses: Manage comorbid depression and anxiety disorder
usesDetails:
Uses Of SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET
Manage comorbid depression and anxiety disorder
mechanismOfAction:
How SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET Works

SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET is a combination of Clonazepam and Escitalopram, where Clonazepam is a benzodiazepine that increases the action of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), a chemical messenger that suppresses the abnormal activity of the nerve cells in the brain. Escitalopram is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) that increases the levels of serotonin, a chemical messenger that improves mood.

How to use SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET

Take SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medication. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration of SZETALO PLUS 5 TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET

HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
usesDetails:
Uses Of HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)
Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
mechanismOfAction:
How HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET Works

HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET

Take HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Have any psychiatric disorders (such as schizophrenia)
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Have poor blood supply to the brain

HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics

HYPNORIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as it could relax the muscles and increase the risk of fall or injuries in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET

ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET Works

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antipsychotics such as clozapine, haloperidol, and chlorpromazine (medicines used to manage mental illness)
Antidepressants such as sertraline, venlafaxine, fluoxetine, bupropion, and desipramine (medicines used to manage depression)
Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)
Opioids such as codeine, methadone, tramadol, pethidine, oxycodone, and morphine (medicines used for severe pain and cough)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Ketoconazole, and itraconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Overdosage:

If you or anybody else accidentally take too much ZEDTIME 10MG TABLET, consult your doctor or visit the nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of overdose are drowsiness, confusion, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.

introduction:
Introduction About TRICLOCALM SYRUP

TRICLOCALM SYRUP contains Triclofos which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedative and Hypnotics. It is used for insomnia, recurrent colic with persistent crying, excitability, restlessness and convulsions in children. It is also used to provide sedation (calming down effect) in states of tension and anxiety and before any medical procedure. During management with TRICLOCALM SYRUP, your doctor may want to monitor your child’s respiration rate, heart rate, oxygen saturation level in the blood.

TRICLOCALM SYRUP is not recommended for use if your child’s is allergic to Triclofos, chloral hydrate or any other ingredients and have porphyria (blood disorder). TRICLOCALM SYRUP should be taken with caution since prolonged use of this medicine may cause dependence.

Before giving TRICLOCALM SYRUP inform your doctor if your child has any liver, kidney, respiratory and heart diseases to avoid unwanted side effects. The most common side effects of taking TRICLOCALM SYRUP includes nausea, vomiting, tiredness, drowsiness, impaired coordination. Consult doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.

TRICLOCALM SYRUP contains Triclofos that has sedative and hypnotic effects. It helps to provide adequate sleep and relaxation by suppressing the brain centres that are responsible for keeping awake and anxious.

Your doctor will decide the correct duration for your child depending upon the age, body weight and severity of present condition.

Introduction About DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET

DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking DACTIVE SR 12.5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

introduction:
Introduction About ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET

ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET contains Etizolam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is used in the management of short-term anxiety. Anxiety is a mental health disease characterized by fear, worry, and excessive nervousness.

ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET is also used to manage insomnia. Insomnia is a sleep disease that causes trouble in falling asleep or staying asleep.

ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET can have a serious side effect like suicidal thoughts, consult your doctor immediately if you have suicidal or aggressive thoughts.

ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease, lung diseases, myasthenia gravis, acute narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye), chronic psychosis, or porphyria.

Before taking ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, alcohol addiction, or personality disorders. ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET can be used in children and adolescents. However, consult with your child’s doctor before giving it to your child.

In elderly patients, ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET should be used with caution. The most common side effects of taking ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET are decreased heart rate, impaired coordination, sleepiness, yawning, decreased appetite, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth and headache. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET

Manage:

Short-term anxiety
Insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET Works

ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET work by increasing the activity of GABA (a chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent) and inducing sleep. Thereby, relaxes muscles, reduces anxiety, and helps to fall asleep.
usageDetails:
How to use ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET

Take ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Take this medicine with or without meals.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet, Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take ETINAP 0.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: PEDIREST Syrup 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About PEDIREST SYRUP

PEDIREST SYRUP contains Triclofos which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedative and Hypnotics. It is used for insomnia, recurrent colic with persistent crying, excitability, restlessness and convulsions in children. It is also used to provide sedation (calming down effect) in states of tension and anxiety and before any medical procedure. During management with PEDIREST SYRUP, your doctor may want to monitor your child’s respiration rate, heart rate, oxygen saturation level in the blood.

PEDIREST SYRUP is not recommended for use if your child’s is allergic to Triclofos, chloral hydrate or any other ingredients and have porphyria (blood disorder). PEDIREST SYRUP should be taken with caution since prolonged use of this medicine may cause dependence.

Before giving PEDIREST SYRUP inform your doctor if your child has any liver, kidney, respiratory and heart diseases to avoid unwanted side effects. The most common side effects of taking PEDIREST SYRUP includes nausea, vomiting, tiredness, drowsiness, impaired coordination. Consult doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.

How PEDIREST SYRUP Works

PEDIREST SYRUP contains Triclofos that has sedative and hypnotic effects. It helps to provide adequate sleep and relaxation by suppressing the brain centres that are responsible for keeping awake and anxious.

Your doctor will decide the correct duration for your child depending upon the age, body weight and severity of present condition.

Introduction About ZILION SL 10MG TABLET

ZILION SL 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZILION SL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZILION SL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZILION SL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZILION SL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZILION SL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZILION SL 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

ZILION SL 10MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take ZILION SL 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DORMIN 5MG TABLET

DORMIN 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

DORMIN 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take DORMIN 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking DORMIN 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking DORMIN 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

DORMIN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

DORMIN 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking DORMIN 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking DORMIN 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking DORMIN 5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How DORMIN 5MG TABLET Works

DORMIN 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use DORMIN 5MG TABLET

Take DORMIN 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking DORMIN 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Introduction About ZOLNAP 10MG TABLET

ZOLNAP 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLNAP 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLNAP 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLNAP 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLNAP 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLNAP 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLNAP 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

mechanismOfAction:

ZOLNAP 10MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take ZOLNAP 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ETINAP 1MG TABLET

ETINAP 1MG TABLET contains Etizolam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is used in the management of short-term anxiety. Anxiety is a mental health disease characterized by fear, worry, and excessive nervousness.

ETINAP 1MG TABLET is also used to manage insomnia. Insomnia is a sleep disease that causes trouble in falling asleep or staying asleep.

ETINAP 1MG TABLET can have a serious side effect like suicidal thoughts, consult your doctor immediately if you have suicidal or aggressive thoughts.

ETINAP 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver disease, lung diseases, myasthenia gravis, acute narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye), chronic psychosis, or porphyria.

Before taking ETINAP 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, alcohol addiction, or personality disorders. ETINAP 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. ETINAP 1MG TABLET can be used in children and adolescents. However, consult with your child’s doctor before giving it to your child.

In elderly patients, ETINAP 1MG TABLET should be used with caution. The most common side effects of taking ETINAP 1MG TABLET are decreased heart rate, impaired coordination, sleepiness, yawning, decreased appetite, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth and headache. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

Insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How ETINAP 1MG TABLET Works

ETINAP 1MG TABLET work by increasing the activity of GABA (a chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent) and inducing sleep. Thereby, relaxes muscles, reduces anxiety, and helps to fall asleep.
usageDetails:
How to use ETINAP 1MG TABLET

Take ETINAP 1MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Take this medicine with or without meals.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow ETINAP 1MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet, Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place ETINAP 1MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take ETINAP 1MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET

HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
usesDetails:
Uses Of HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)
Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
mechanismOfAction:
How HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET Works

HYPNORIL 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:

introduction:
Introduction About ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET

ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET contains Zopiclone which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics and Sedatives. It is indicated for the short-term management and symptomatic relief of insomnia characterized by difficulty in falling asleep, frequent nocturnal awakenings and or early morning awakenings.

Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep. You may still feel tired when you wake up. It also affects your health, work performance and quality of life.

ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping) and in patients who had stroke. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from depression or any other mental illness, personality disorder, kidney disease, somnambulism (sleep walking), thyroid disorder, epilepsy (seizures). Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET are dry mouth, bitter or metallic taste, feeling sleepy or drowsy, headache and fatigue, dizziness, lightheadedness and difficulty with coordination. Contact your doctor if you get any side effects. Specific serious side effects include suicidal thoughts in some patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience such thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET
Manage insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET Works

ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET helps to improve your sleep by binding to benzodiazepine receptors in brain and increases the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA (a neurotransmitter helps to transfer messages in the brain) and produces a calming effect on the brain. Thus, helps to manage sleep disorders.

Take ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Had stroke
Ever experienced sleepwalking or other unusual behaviour while not being fully awake after taking ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET

Personality disorder
Depression and any other mental illness such as psychoses, schizophrenia
A history of drug abuse
Periodic limb movement disorder (involuntary moving the limbs in sleep)
Restless legs syndrome (an urge to move legs constantly)
Surgery or anaesthesia
Somnambulism (sleep walking)
Thyroid disorder
Epilepsy (seizures)

ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZOPICALM 7.5 MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as they are more susceptible to the sedative effects of this medicine associated with giddiness, ataxia and confusion, which may increase the possibility of a fall. Consult your doctor before taking.

Introduction About NITRAVET 10MG TABLET

NITRAVET 10MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITRAVET 10MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITRAVET 10MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITRAVET 10MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITRAVET 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITRAVET 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITRAVET 10MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITRAVET 10MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITRAVET 10MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITRAVET 10MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How NITRAVET 10MG TABLET Works

NITRAVET 10MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NITRAVET 10MG TABLET

Take NITRAVET 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITRAVET 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Introduction About ZOLWAY 5MG TABLET

ZOLWAY 5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLWAY 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLWAY 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLWAY 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLWAY 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLWAY 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLWAY 5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET

ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET Works

ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

How to use ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET

Take ZOLPIGRESS 12.5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MEZOLAM INJECTION

MEZOLAM INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MEZOLAM INJECTION. Do not receive MEZOLAM INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MEZOLAM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MEZOLAM INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MEZOLAM INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults

It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults

It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults
It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults
mechanismOfAction:
How MEZOLAM INJECTION Works

MEZOLAM INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MEZOLAM INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.
usageDetails:
How to use MEZOLAM INJECTION

MEZOLAM INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET

ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:

Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET Works

ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antipsychotics such as clozapine, haloperidol, and chlorpromazine (medicines used to manage mental illness)
Antidepressants such as sertraline, venlafaxine, fluoxetine, bupropion, and desipramine (medicines used to manage depression)
Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)
Opioids such as codeine, methadone, tramadol, pethidine, oxycodone, and morphine (medicines used for severe pain and cough)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Ketoconazole, and itraconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Overdosage:

If you or anybody else accidentally take too much ZOLPEACE 5 TABLET, consult your doctor or visit the nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of overdose are drowsiness, confusion, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.
