Introduction About ZENEX 10 TABLET

ZENEX 10 TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZENEX 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZENEX 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZENEX 10 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZENEX 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZENEX 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZENEX 10 TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZENEX 10 TABLET Works

ZENEX 10 TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take ZENEX 10 TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: SEDOZ Injection 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About SEDOZ INJECTION

SEDOZ INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving SEDOZ INJECTION. Do not receive SEDOZ INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving SEDOZ INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

SEDOZ INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. SEDOZ INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How SEDOZ INJECTION Works

SEDOZ INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, SEDOZ INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

How to use SEDOZ INJECTION

SEDOZ INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ZOLIDAC 5MG TABLET

ZOLIDAC 5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLIDAC 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLIDAC 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLIDAC 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLIDAC 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLIDAC 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLIDAC 5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

introduction:
Introduction About GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET

GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET Works

GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET

Take GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Consult your doctor before taking GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET.

GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET.
GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET.
Do not take GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET if you are allergic to Zopiclone or lactose or other lactose other ingredients in the medicine.

GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients with severe respiratory disorders or breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor before taking GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET.
GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from heart diseases including slow or uneven heartbeat. Consult your doctor before taking GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET.

Others

Myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Mental illness or psychosis or depression

Depression and any other mental illness
Drug abuse
Plans to take a blood test to check liver function
Thoughts of harming or killing yourself
Fits

Use in paediatrics:

GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients more than 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antipsychotics such as clozapine, haloperidol, and chlorpromazine (medicines used to manage mental illness)
Antidepressants such as sertraline, venlafaxine, fluoxetine, bupropion, and desipramine (medicines used to manage depression)
Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)
Opioids such as codeine, methadone, tramadol, pethidine, oxycodone, and morphine (medicines used for severe pain and cough)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Ketoconazole, and itraconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Overdosage:

If you or anybody else accidentally take too much GOODNOCT XR 6.25MG TABLET, consult your doctor or visit the nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of overdose are drowsiness, confusion, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.

name: Dexmedine 200mcg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION

DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
usesDetails:
Uses Of DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION
To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
mechanismOfAction:
How DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION Works

DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION

DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.

warnings.details: DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION.
DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION should not be used in breast feeding women unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION.

DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION has major impact on the ability to drive and use machines. After you have been given this medicine, you must not drive, operate machinery or work in dangerous situations until the effects are completely gone. Ask your doctor when you can start doing these activities again and when you can go back to this kind of work.
Talk to your doctor about the use of alcohol after sedation/wake-up.
DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION.
DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION.
Do not receive this medicine if you are allergic to dexmedetomidine or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders (heart block grade 2 or 3), very low blood pressure which does not respond to> management. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

Others

DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION is not recommended for you, if you have:

Recently had a stroke or other serious condition affecting blood supply to the brain

Before receiving DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have:

Low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding)
Neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke)
Ever developed a serious fever after taking some medicines called anaesthetics
Diabetes mellitus

Use in pediatrics:

The safety and efficacy of DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION in pediatric patients have not been established for procedural or ICU sedation. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION.

Use in geriatrics:

DEXMEDINE 200MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years due to increased risk of low heart rate and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

name: Midzee 1mg Injection 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION

MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION. Do not receive MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults

It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION
It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults
It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults
mechanismOfAction:
How MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION Works

MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.
usageDetails:
How to use MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION

MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET

STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

Uses Of STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET Works

STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take STILNOCT 6.25MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NITRAVET 5MG TABLET

NITRAVET 5MG TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

NITRAVET 5MG TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take NITRAVET 5MG TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

NITRAVET 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

NITRAVET 5MG TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
usesDetails:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)
Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
mechanismOfAction:
How NITRAVET 5MG TABLET Works

NITRAVET 5MG TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use NITRAVET 5MG TABLET

Take NITRAVET 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking NITRAVET 5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.

Introduction About KABIZOLAM 1MG INJECTION

KABIZOLAM 1MG INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving KABIZOLAM 1MG INJECTION. Do not receive KABIZOLAM 1MG INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving KABIZOLAM 1MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

KABIZOLAM 1MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. KABIZOLAM 1MG INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About MIDAZ INJECTION

MIDAZ INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MIDAZ INJECTION. Do not receive MIDAZ INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MIDAZ INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MIDAZ INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MIDAZ INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How MIDAZ INJECTION Works

MIDAZ INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MIDAZ INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

MIDAZ INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: MIDAZOM 0.5 Nasal Spray 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY

MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called benzodiazepines (sedatives). MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY is used to manage sudden repetitive attacks of fits (epilepsy). Epilepsy (fits) is a central nervous system (neurological) disorder which affects the brain creating a disturbance in nerve cells and electrical activity leading to sudden, uncontrolled body movements. Epilepsy can be triggered by sleep deprivation, stress, missing medications, illness with fever or using alcohol and other nonmedical drugs.

Before using MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have chronic respiratory problems, myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), a history of drug abuse or depression, narrow-angle glaucoma, sleep apnoea syndrome (sleep disorder in which breathing stops and starts repeatedly), kidney, heart, liver problems.

MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY is generally not recommended during pregnancy especially in the last trimester and breastfeeding, unless deemed necessary. MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients and children. MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY has a few side effects like nausea, vomiting, headache, drowsiness, runny nose, throat irritation, nasal discomfort and dizziness in some cases. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY

MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY nasal spray is used for emergencies to stop cluster seizures (episodes of increased seizure activity) in adults and children 12 years of age and older who are taking other medications to manage epilepsy (seizures).
mechanismOfAction:
How MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY Works

MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY contains midazolam which works by increasing a particular chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent (GABA) resulting in sedative, hypnotic (sleep-inducing), anxiolytic (anti-anxiety), anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant properties. Hence MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY helps manage fits by stabilizing the altered, electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY

Use MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY is for nasal use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY is used with caution for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before using it.

Rifampicin to manage tuberculosis
Medicines for HIV called protease inhibitors (Ex. saquinavir)
Antibiotics to manage infection (Ex. erythromycin or clarithromycin)
Medicines to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, voriconazole, fluconazole, itraconazole,)

Medicines for high blood pressure (Ex. diltiazem)

If you or anyone else accidentally used too much of MIDAZOM 0.5 NASAL SPRAY, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose may include feeling sick (nausea), vomiting, dizziness, slowing of breathing, drowsiness or coma, slurred speech, loss of balance, and slow reactions.

name: Zolpirest 10mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET

ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET Works

ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET

Take ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not consume alcohol while taking ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET as it can cause difficulty in breathing or walking, or put you in a very deep sleep. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET.
ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET.
ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET.
Do not take ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Zopiclone or lactose or other lactose other ingredients in the medicine.

ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients with severe respiratory disorders or breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET.
ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from heart diseases including slow or uneven heartbeat. Consult your doctor before taking ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET.

Others

ZOLPIREST 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Mental illness or psychosis or depression

Depression and any other mental illness
Drug abuse
Plans to take a blood test to check liver function
Thoughts of harming or killing yourself
Fits

Use in geriatrics:

introduction:
Introduction About ZONAP TABLET

ZONAP TABLET contains Zopiclone which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics and Sedatives. It is indicated for the short-term management and symptomatic relief of insomnia characterized by difficulty in falling asleep, frequent nocturnal awakenings and or early morning awakenings.

Insomnia is a common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early and not be able to get back to sleep. You may still feel tired when you wake up. It also affects your health, work performance and quality of life.

ZONAP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping) and in patients who had stroke. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZONAP TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from depression or any other mental illness, personality disorder, kidney disease, somnambulism (sleep walking), thyroid disorder, epilepsy (seizures). Consult your doctor before taking.

ZONAP TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

ZONAP TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

ZONAP TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking ZONAP TABLET are dry mouth, bitter or metallic taste, feeling sleepy or drowsy, headache and fatigue, dizziness, lightheadedness and difficulty with coordination. Contact your doctor if you get any side effects. Specific serious side effects include suicidal thoughts in some patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience such thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZONAP TABLET
Manage insomnia
mechanismOfAction:
How ZONAP TABLET Works

ZONAP TABLET helps to improve your sleep by binding to benzodiazepine receptors in brain and increases the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA (a neurotransmitter helps to transfer messages in the brain) and produces a calming effect on the brain. Thus, helps to manage sleep disorders.
usageDetails:
How to use ZONAP TABLET

Take ZONAP TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NUCLORYL ORAL SOLUTION

NUCLORYL ORAL SOLUTION contains Triclofos which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedative and Hypnotics. It is used for insomnia, recurrent colic with persistent crying, excitability, restlessness and convulsions in children. It is also used to provide sedation (calming down effect) in states of tension and anxiety and before any medical procedure. During management with NUCLORYL ORAL SOLUTION, your doctor may want to monitor your child’s respiration rate, heart rate, oxygen saturation level in the blood.

NUCLORYL ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use if your child’s is allergic to Triclofos, chloral hydrate or any other ingredients and have porphyria (blood disorder). NUCLORYL ORAL SOLUTION should be taken with caution since prolonged use of this medicine may cause dependence.

Before giving NUCLORYL ORAL SOLUTION inform your doctor if your child has any liver, kidney, respiratory and heart diseases to avoid unwanted side effects. The most common side effects of taking NUCLORYL ORAL SOLUTION includes nausea, vomiting, tiredness, drowsiness, impaired coordination. Consult doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.
usesDetails:

Insomnia
Recurrent colic with persistent crying
Excitability, restlessness
Convulsions
mechanismOfAction:
How NUCLORYL ORAL SOLUTION Works

NUCLORYL ORAL SOLUTION contains Triclofos that has sedative and hypnotic effects. It helps to provide adequate sleep and relaxation by suppressing the brain centres that are responsible for keeping awake and anxious.

Give NUCLORYL ORAL SOLUTION exactly as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. It can be taken with or without food. Do not stop giving NUCLORYL ORAL SOLUTION before doctor’s advice. Your doctor will decide the correct duration for your child depending upon the age, body weight and severity of present condition.

introduction:
Introduction About STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET

STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET Works

STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET

Take STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Dextomid 50mcg Injection 0.5ml
introduction:
Introduction About DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
usesDetails:
Uses Of DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION
To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
mechanismOfAction:
How DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION Works

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.
sideEffects: Change in breathing pattern or shortness of breath
Hallucinations (seeing or hearing things that are not present)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION
Common
Slow or fast heart rate
Low or high blood pressure
Change in breathing pattern or shortness of breath
Chest pain or heart attack
Nausea, vomiting or dry mouth
Restlessness
High temperature
Uncommon
Hallucinations (seeing or hearing things that are not present)
Reduced heart function, cardiac arrest
Swelling of the stomach
Thirst

warnings.details: DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION.
DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION should not be used in breast feeding women unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION.

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION has major impact on the ability to drive and use machines. After you have been given this medicine, you must not drive, operate machinery or work in dangerous situations until the effects are completely gone. Ask your doctor when you can start doing these activities again and when you can go back to this kind of work.
Talk to your doctor about the use of alcohol after sedation/wake-up.
DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION.
DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION.
Do not receive this medicine if you are allergic to dexmedetomidine or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders (heart block grade 2 or 3), very low blood pressure which does not respond to> management. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

Others

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION is not recommended for you, if you have:

Recently had a stroke or other serious condition affecting blood supply to the brain

Before receiving DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have:

Low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding)
Neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke)
Ever developed a serious fever after taking some medicines called anaesthetics
Diabetes mellitus

Use in pediatrics:

The safety and efficacy of DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION in pediatric patients have not been established for procedural or ICU sedation. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION.

Use in geriatrics:

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years due to increased risk of low heart rate and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

Ask your doctor when you can start doing these activities again and when you can go back to this kind of work.

Talk to your doctor about the use of alcohol after sedation/wake-up.

Kidney

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION.

Liver

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION.

Do not receive this medicine if you are allergic to dexmedetomidine or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Heart Disease

DEXTOMID 50MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders (heart block grade 2 or 3), very low blood pressure which does not respond to> management. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About PRIDEP PLUS TABLET

PRIDEP PLUS TABLETcontains a combination of Clonazepam and Escitalopram which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is indicated for the management of comorbid depression and anxiety disorder.

Comorbid depression and anxiety disorder is condition in which the person has anxiety and depression together at the same time. Symptoms are persistent feeling of sadness or loss of interest, changes in sleep, appetite, energy level, concentration or daily behavior, feeling nervous or restless, fast heartrate, heavy breathing.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with PRIDEP PLUS TABLET. PRIDEP PLUS TABLET is not recommended to use in patients having liver or heart diseases, acute narrow-angle glaucoma (increased pressure within the eye) or if you are taking MAO inhibitors such as isocarboxazid or moclobemide (to manage depression), selegiline (used to manage Parkinson’s disease) or linezolid (an antibiotic).

Before taking PRIDEP PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver or, lung diseases, epilepsy, low levels of sodium, tendency of bleeding and bruising and diabetes. Patients should be monitored for signs of suicidal ideation and behaviors and advised to seek immediate medical advice if any such signs occur.

PRIDEP PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking it. PRIDEP PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (18 years and below).PRIDEP PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking PRIDEP PLUS TABLET are nausea, headache, diarrhea, constipation, dry mouth, increased sweating, increased or decreased appetite, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists.
uses: Manage comorbid depression and anxiety disorder

Uses Of PRIDEP PLUS TABLET
Manage comorbid depression and anxiety disorder
mechanismOfAction:
How PRIDEP PLUS TABLET Works

PRIDEP PLUS TABLET is a combination of Clonazepam and Escitalopram, where Clonazepam is a benzodiazepine that increases the action of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), a chemical messenger that suppresses the abnormal activity of the nerve cells in the brain. Escitalopram is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) that increases the levels of serotonin, a chemical messenger that improves mood.

Take PRIDEP PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medication. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration of PRIDEP PLUS TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DIZERAL AZ M TABLET

DIZERAL AZ M TABLET is a combination of Alprazolam and Propranolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Anxiolytics and Antihypertensive agents respectively. It is used to manage anxiety and panic attacks. It can also be used to reduce elevated heart rate and blood pressure associated with anxiety. It is also capable of reducing tremor (shakiness), restlessness and migraine headache among the affected patients.

Before taking DIZERAL AZ M TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your heart, liver or kidneys. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, muscle weakness, depression with suicidal thoughts, any mental illnesses, history of alcoholism or drug abuse or thyroid problems as a precaution. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine as it may make you feel more dizzy or drowsy.

Do not take DIZERAL AZ M TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking this medicine are depression, headache, dizziness, drowsiness, forgetfulness, constipation, dry mouth, decreased sex drive, problems in erection, blurred vision, cold hands and feet, slow heartbeat and problems in sleeping. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience suicidal thoughts or any other unusual changes in behaviour (such as agitation, restlessness, aggressiveness, irritability, violence or anger).

mechanismOfAction:
How DIZERAL AZ M TABLET Works

DIZERAL AZ M TABLET contains two medicines namely alprazolam and propranolol. Alprazolam is a hypnotic medicine. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces sleep.

Propranolol is a beta-blocker. It reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of the heart which, therefore reduces abnormal heart signs (such as racing heartbeat, nervousness and high blood pressure) associated with anxiety.

It can also relax the blood vessels supplying the heart and the brain which therefore reduces elevated blood pressure, chest pain and migraine.

It also stops the transfer of abnormal nerve signals between the brain and the muscles which helps in reducing tremors.
usageDetails:
How to use DIZERAL AZ M TABLET

Take DIZERAL AZ M TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not take this medicine for more than 4 weeks without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET

GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET Works

GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Take GOODNOCT XR 12.5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION

SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION. Do not receive SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION Works

SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

How to use SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION

SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. STILNOCT 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. introduction:
Introduction About MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION

MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION. Do not receive MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION Works

MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.
usageDetails:
How to use MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION

MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION.

Others

Have myasthenia gravis
Have sleep apnoea syndrome
Have ever had alcohol or drug problems

MIDZEE 1MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly (60 years and above) patients because there is an increased risk of fall, fractures and life-threatening side effects. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXTOMID 100MCG INJECTION

DEXTOMID 100MCG INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

DEXTOMID 100MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXTOMID 100MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXTOMID 100MCG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXTOMID 100MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXTOMID 100MCG INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures

mechanismOfAction:
How DEXTOMID 100MCG INJECTION Works

DEXTOMID 100MCG INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.

How to use DEXTOMID 100MCG INJECTION

DEXTOMID 100MCG INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.

name: Insomin Forte Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About INSOMIN FORTE TABLET

INSOMIN FORTE TABLET contains Nitrazepam which belongs to the group of medicines called Hypnotic agents. It is used for the short-term management of insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep). It can also be used in management of a type of epilepsy called myoclonic seizures (sudden, jerky muscle movements).

INSOMIN FORTE TABLET shortens the time required to fall asleep and lengthens the duration of the sleep. Take INSOMIN FORTE TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking INSOMIN FORTE TABLET as it could make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

Before taking INSOMIN FORTE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any muscle problems, depression, anxiety, any psychiatric disorders, epilepsy or a history of alcoholism or drug abuse as a precaution.

INSOMIN FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years.

INSOMIN FORTE TABLET may reduce alertness and induce excessive drowsiness in patients. Therefore, it should not be overdosed or misused by the patients. Patients must also avoid driving or handling any heavy tools while taking INSOMIN FORTE TABLET as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking INSOMIN FORTE TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, muscle weakness, feeling unsteady, lack of coordination, reduced alertness, tiredness and headache. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any suicidal thoughts after taking INSOMIN FORTE TABLET.
uses: Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
usesDetails:
Uses Of INSOMIN FORTE TABLET

It is used to manage:

Insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep)
Myoclonic seizures (fits causing sudden jerky muscle movements)
mechanismOfAction:
How INSOMIN FORTE TABLET Works

INSOMIN FORTE TABLET is a hypnotic medicine. It works by increasing the activity of certain brain chemicals (GABA) that reduces anxiety, relaxes body muscle and induces sleep. This produces a calming effect on the brain and shortens the time required for falling asleep. Additionally, it can also suppress the abnormal electrical signals in the brain which helps in reducing the onset of seizures.
usageDetails:
How to use INSOMIN FORTE TABLET

Take INSOMIN FORTE TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Do not stop taking INSOMIN FORTE TABLET without consulting your doctor as it may lead to recurrence of sleep problems or can cause withdrawal symptoms such as anxiety, nervousness, restlessness, mood changes, confusion, irritability, sweating, diarrhoea, headaches, muscle weakness, changes in behaviour, numbness and tingling of the extremities, fits, over-sensitivity to light, noise and touch and hallucination.
sideEffects: Signs of severe allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat or tongue causing difficulty in breathing or swallowing)

Severe skin reactions (such as skin rash with itching and redness, blistering and peeling of skin, skin swelling and inflammation of mucous membrane, skin lesions with a pink/red ring and a pale center which may be itchy, scaly or filled with fluid accompanied with fever and tiredness)
Worsening of depression, suicidal thoughts or behavior
Yellowing of skin and whites of the eye (signs of liver problems)
Behavioural changes (such as aggression, excitement, confusion, restlessness, agitation, irritability, rages, hallucinations, nightmares and depression)

warnings.details: INSOMIN FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may harm the growing baby. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking INSOMIN FORTE TABLET if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant.
INSOMIN FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive and use heavy machinery while taking INSOMIN FORTE TABLET as it could reduce alertness and induce drowsiness with poor muscle coordination.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking INSOMIN FORTE TABLET as it may make you feel dizzier.
INSOMIN FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

INSOMIN FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take INSOMIN FORTE TABLET if you are allergic to Nitrazepam or to any other benzodiazepines (such as clonazepam, diazepam).

INSOMIN FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe lung diseases (such as COPD). It should be used with caution in patients with mild lung problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
INSOMIN FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

INSOMIN FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have any breathing difficulties
Have sleep apnea (breathing difficulties during sleep)
Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness and tenderness)
Have any psychiatric disorders (such as schizophrenia)
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Before taking INSOMIN FORTE TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are in depression or have a history of depression
Have anxiety or any other mental illnesses
Are alcoholic
Have low albumin levels in blood
Have poor blood supply to the brain
Have epilepsy
Have an history of alcoholism or drug abuse

Use in Pediatrics

INSOMIN FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics

INSOMIN FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients as it could relax the muscles and increase the risk of fall or injuries in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions

Before taking INSOMIN FORTE TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage depress brain such as antidepressants (Ex. fluoxetine, sertraline), hypnotics (Ex. alprazolam, midazolam), neuroleptics (Ex. haloperidol)
Anaesthetics (used to cause numbness of body parts or loss of consciousness) Ex. lignocaine, sevoflurane
Antihistamines (used to manage allergic symptoms) Ex. cetirizine
Lofexidine (a medicine used to manage withdrawal symptoms of opioids)
Nabilone (a medicine used to manage nausea and vomiting)
Opioid analgesics (used for pain relief) such as morphine, fentanyl, pethidine
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin and phenobarbital)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Moxonidine (a medicine used to reduce high blood pressure)
Muscle relaxants (used to reduce muscle spasms) Ex. baclofen, tizanidine
Erythromycin (a medicine used to manage bacterial infections)
Cimetidine (a medicine used to manage stomach ulcers)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more INSOMIN FORTE TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose might include drowsiness, confusion, muscle relaxation, lack of coordination, decreased blood pressure, and extremely slow and/or shallow breathing and pulse.

introduction:
Introduction About SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET

SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET Works

SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

Such birth defects include cleft lip, cleft palate, reduced foetal movement and foetal heart rate variability, muscle weakness, low body temperature (hypothermia), difficulty feeding and breathing problems (respiratory depression). SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET.
SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET.
Do not take SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Zopiclone or lactose or other lactose other ingredients in the medicine.

SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from sleep apnoea (severe breathing disorder in sleep) and in patients with severe respiratory disorders or breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor before taking SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET.
SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from heart diseases including slow or uneven heartbeat. Consult your doctor before taking SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET.

Others

SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Mental illness or psychosis or depression

Before taking SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Depression and any other mental illness
Drug abuse
Plans to take a blood test to check liver function
Thoughts of harming or killing yourself
Fits

Use in paediatrics:

SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients more than 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antipsychotics such as clozapine, haloperidol, and chlorpromazine (medicines used to manage mental illness)
Antidepressants such as sertraline, venlafaxine, fluoxetine, bupropion, and desipramine (medicines used to manage depression)
Antiepileptics such as phenobarbital, phenytoin, and carbamazepine (medicines used to manage epilepsy)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)
Chlorphenamine, and promethazine (medicines used to manage hay fever or allergies)
Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)
Opioids such as codeine, methadone, tramadol, pethidine, oxycodone, and morphine (medicines used for severe pain and cough)
Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Ketoconazole, and itraconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

Overdosage:

If you or anybody else accidentally take too much SOVE IT 12.5MG TABLET, consult your doctor or visit the nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of overdose are drowsiness, confusion, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.

name: Fulsed Injection 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About FULSED INJECTION

FULSED INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving FULSED INJECTION. Do not receive FULSED INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving FULSED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

FULSED INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. FULSED INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults

Uses Of FULSED INJECTION
It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults
It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FULSED INJECTION Works

FULSED INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, FULSED INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.
usageDetails:
How to use FULSED INJECTION

FULSED INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

Have myasthenia gravis
Have sleep apnoea syndrome
Have ever had alcohol or drug problems

FULSED INJECTION should be cautious in infants, children and adolescents (less than 6 months to 16 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in geriatrics:

FULSED INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly (60 years and above) patients because there is an increased risk of fall, fractures and life-threatening side effects. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.
