FULSED INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receving the medicine.

Breastfeeding

FULSED INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Do not breastfeed for 24 hours after receiving FULSED INJECTION. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Driving and Using Machines

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, sleepy forgetful or impaired concentration and coordination after receiving FULSED INJECTION.

Alcohol

Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving FULSED INJECTION because it may make you feel very sleepy and cause breathing problems.

Kidney

FULSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving FULSED INJECTION.

Liver

FULSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving FULSED INJECTION.

Allergy

Do not receive FULSED INJECTION if you are allergic to midazolam or other benzodiazepine medicines, such as diazepam or nitrazepam.

Lungs

FULSED INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe breathing problems. Consult your doctor before receiving FULSED INJECTION.

Heart Disease

FULSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving FULSED INJECTION.

Others

Before receiving FULSED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have an illness that makes you feel very weak, run down and short of energy
Have myasthenia gravis
Have sleep apnoea syndrome
Have ever had alcohol or drug problems

Use in paediatrics:

FULSED INJECTION should be cautious in infants, children and adolescents (less than 6 months to 16 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in geriatrics:

FULSED INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly (60 years and above) patients because there is an increased risk of fall, fractures and life-threatening side effects. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

Introduction About ZOLNAP XR 12.5MG TABLET

ZOLNAP XR 12.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLNAP XR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLNAP XR 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLNAP XR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLNAP XR 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLNAP XR 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLNAP XR 12.5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

Anaesthetics (medicines used to cause numbness or awareness)

Medicines used to induce calm or reduce anxiety or for managing sleep problems (hypnotics) Ex. diazepam, alprazolam, etc
St. John’s Wort (a medicine used to manage depression and mood swings)
Skeletal muscle relaxants Ex. baclofen (a medicine used to relax muscles)

Rifampicin (a medicine used to manage tuberculosis)

Clarithromycin, erythromycin, ciprofloxacin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Ritonavir (medicines used to manage HIV infection)
Fluvoxamine (medicines used to manage obsessive-compulsive disorder)

If you or anybody else accidentally take too much ZOLNAP XR 12.5MG TABLET, consult your doctor or visit the nearest hospital immediately. Symptoms of overdose are drowsiness, confusion, sleeping deeply and possibly falling into a coma.

name: Midacip Nasal Spray 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY

MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called benzodiazepines (sedatives). MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY is used to manage sudden repetitive attacks of fits (epilepsy). Epilepsy (fits) is a central nervous system (neurological) disorder which affects the brain creating a disturbance in nerve cells and electrical activity leading to sudden, uncontrolled body movements. Epilepsy can be triggered by sleep deprivation, stress, missing medications, illness with fever or using alcohol and other nonmedical drugs.

Before using MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have chronic respiratory problems, myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), a history of drug abuse or depression, narrow-angle glaucoma, sleep apnoea syndrome (sleep disorder in which breathing stops and starts repeatedly), kidney, heart, liver problems.

MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY is generally not recommended during pregnancy especially in the last trimester and breastfeeding, unless deemed necessary. MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients and children. MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY has a few side effects like nausea, vomiting, headache, drowsiness, runny nose, throat irritation, nasal discomfort and dizziness in some cases. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY

MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY nasal spray is used for emergencies to stop cluster seizures (episodes of increased seizure activity) in adults and children 12 years of age and older who are taking other medications to manage epilepsy (seizures).
mechanismOfAction:
How MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY Works

MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY contains midazolam which works by increasing a particular chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent (GABA) resulting in sedative, hypnotic (sleep-inducing), anxiolytic (anti-anxiety), anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant properties. Hence MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY helps manage fits by stabilizing the altered, electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY

Use MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY as advised by your physician. MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY is for nasal use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before using it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after using MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY.
Do not drink alcohol if you are using MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY. This is because alcohol may make you feel very sleepy and cause problems with your breathing.
MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases. Consult your doctor before using MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY.
MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Consult your doctor before using MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY.

Do not use MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY if you are allergic to midazolam. Allergic reactions to MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY are rare but may show as an itchy rash. Very rarely, a severe allergic reaction may occur causing a sudden onset of swelling of the face and neck, and shortness of breath.
MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in patients with respiratory diseases. Consult your doctor before using MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY.
MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases. Consult your doctor before using MIDACIP NASAL SPRAY.

introduction:
Introduction About ETINAP FORTE TABLET

ETINAP FORTE TABLET is a combination of Escitalopram and Etizolam which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants and Anxiolytics respectively. It is used to manage depression, obsessive-compulsive disorder, major depressive episodes, panic disorder, anxiety disorder and insomnia.

ETINAP FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with myasthenia gravis, acute angle-closure glaucoma, sleep disorder and porphyria. Contact your doctor before taking. Before taking ETINAP FORTE TABLET inform your doctor if you have lung, liver or kidney disease or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking. ETINAP FORTE TABLET is not recommended in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Contact your doctor before taking. ETINAP FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking. The most common side effects of this medicine are confusion, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, memory impairment, drowsiness and tiredness. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:

Depression
Obsessive-compulsive disorder
Major depressive episodes
Panic disorder
Anxiety disorder and

mechanismOfAction:
How ETINAP FORTE TABLET Works

ETINAP FORTE TABLET is a combination of Escitalopram and Etizolam. Escitalopram increases the levels of serotonin, a chemical messenger that improves mood. Etizolam increases the action of GABA, a chemical messenger that suppresses the abnormal activity of the nerve cells in the brain.

Take ETINAP FORTE TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXTOMID 200MCG INJECTION

DEXTOMID 200MCG INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

DEXTOMID 200MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXTOMID 200MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXTOMID 200MCG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXTOMID 200MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXTOMID 200MCG INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEXTOMID 200MCG INJECTION Works

DEXTOMID 200MCG INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use DEXTOMID 200MCG INJECTION

DEXTOMID 200MCG INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About MIDOSED INJECTION

MIDOSED INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MIDOSED INJECTION. Do not receive MIDOSED INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MIDOSED INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MIDOSED INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults

It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults

mechanismOfAction:
How MIDOSED INJECTION Works

MIDOSED INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MIDOSED INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

How to use MIDOSED INJECTION

MIDOSED INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Do not breastfeed for 24 hours after receiving MIDOSED INJECTION. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, sleepy forgetful or impaired concentration and coordination after receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving MIDOSED INJECTION because it may make you feel very sleepy and cause breathing problems.
MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.
MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.
Do not receive MIDOSED INJECTION if you are allergic to midazolam or other benzodiazepine medicines, such as diazepam or nitrazepam.
MIDOSED INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe breathing problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.
MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.

Others

Before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have an illness that makes you feel very weak, run down and short of energy
Have myasthenia gravis
Have sleep apnoea syndrome
Have ever had alcohol or drug problems

Use in paediatrics:

MIDOSED INJECTION should be cautious in infants, children and adolescents (less than 6 months to 16 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in geriatrics:

MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly (60 years and above) patients because there is an increased risk of fall, fractures and life-threatening side effects. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

name: Xamdex 50mcg Injection 0.5ml
introduction:
Introduction About XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION

XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
usesDetails:
Uses Of XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION
To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
mechanismOfAction:
How XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION Works

XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION

XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.
sideEffects: Change in breathing pattern or shortness of breath
Hallucinations (seeing or hearing things that are not present)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION
Common
Slow or fast heart rate
Low or high blood pressure
Change in breathing pattern or shortness of breath
Chest pain or heart attack
Nausea, vomiting or dry mouth
Restlessness
High temperature
Uncommon
Hallucinations (seeing or hearing things that are not present)
Reduced heart function, cardiac arrest
Swelling of the stomach
Thirst

warnings.details: XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION.
XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION should not be used in breast feeding women unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION.

XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION has major impact on the ability to drive and use machines. After you have been given this medicine, you must not drive, operate machinery or work in dangerous situations until the effects are completely gone. Ask your doctor when you can start doing these activities again and when you can go back to this kind of work.
Talk to your doctor about the use of alcohol after sedation/wake-up.
XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION.
XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION.
Do not receive this medicine if you are allergic to dexmedetomidine or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders (heart block grade 2 or 3), very low blood pressure which does not respond to> management. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

Others

XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION is not recommended for you, if you have:

Recently had a stroke or other serious condition affecting blood supply to the brain

Before receiving XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have:

Low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding)
Neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke)
Ever developed a serious fever after taking some medicines called anaesthetics
Diabetes mellitus

Use in pediatrics:

The safety and efficacy of XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION in pediatric patients have not been established for procedural or ICU sedation. Consult your doctor before receiving XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION.

Use in geriatrics:

XAMDEX 50MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years due to increased risk of low heart rate and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION

SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION. Do not receive SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION Works

SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

How to use SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION

SHORTAL 1MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About STILNOCT CR 6.25MG TABLET

STILNOCT CR 6.25MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

STILNOCT CR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

STILNOCT CR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

STILNOCT CR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. STILNOCT CR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. STILNOCT CR 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking STILNOCT CR 6.25MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

mechanismOfAction:
How STILNOCT CR 6.25MG TABLET Works

STILNOCT CR 6.25MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

introduction:
Introduction About MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY

MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called benzodiazepines (sedatives). MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY is used to manage sudden repetitive attacks of fits (epilepsy). Epilepsy (fits) is a central nervous system (neurological) disorder which affects the brain creating a disturbance in nerve cells and electrical activity leading to sudden, uncontrolled body movements. Epilepsy can be triggered by sleep deprivation, stress, missing medications, illness with fever or using alcohol and other nonmedical drugs.

Before taking MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have chronic respiratory problems, myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), a history of drug abuse or depression, narrow-angle glaucoma, sleep apnoea syndrome (sleep disorder in which breathing stops and starts repeatedly), kidney, heart, liver problems.

MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY is generally not recommended during pregnancy especially in the last trimester and breastfeeding, unless deemed necessary. MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients and children. MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY has a few side effects like nausea, vomiting, headache, drowsiness, runny nose, throat irritation, nasal discomfort and dizziness in some cases. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY

MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY nasal spray is used for emergencies to stop cluster seizures (episodes of increased seizure activity) in adults and children 12 years of age and older who are taking other medications to manage epilepsy (seizures).
mechanismOfAction:
How MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY Works

MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY contains midazolam which works by increasing a particular chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent (GABA) resulting in sedative, hypnotic (sleep-inducing), anxiolytic (anti-anxiety), anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant properties. Hence MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY helps manage fits by stabilizing the altered, electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY

Use MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY as advised by your physician. MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY is for nasal use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after using MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY.
Do not drink alcohol if you are using MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY. This is because alcohol may make you feel very sleepy and cause problems with your breathing.

MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Consult your doctor before using MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY.

Do not use MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY if you are allergic to midazolam. Allergic reactions to MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY are rare but may show as an itchy rash. Very rarely, a severe allergic reaction may occur causing a sudden onset of swelling of the face and neck, and shortness of breath.
MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY should be used with caution in patients with respiratory diseases. Consult your doctor before using MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY.
MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases. Consult your doctor before using MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY.

Others

MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY is not recommended for use if you:

Have acute narrow-angle glaucoma

Before using MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY, inform your doctor if you:

Regularly take recreational drugs or drink large amounts of alcohol or have had problems with alcohol or drug abuse in the past
Suffer from mental disorders including depression, psychosis, or schizophrenia

Use in paediatrics:

MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY is used with caution for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before using it.

Use in geriatrics:

MIDASPRAY NASAL 50 METERED SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly (65 years and above) patients. Consult your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About MEZOLAM 10MG INJECTION

MEZOLAM 10MG INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MEZOLAM 10MG INJECTION. Do not receive MEZOLAM 10MG INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MEZOLAM 10MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MEZOLAM 10MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MEZOLAM 10MG INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEZOLAM 10MG INJECTION Works

MEZOLAM 10MG INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MEZOLAM 10MG INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

MEZOLAM 10MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXDINE INJECTION

DEXDINE INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

DEXDINE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXDINE INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXDINE INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXDINE INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXDINE INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
usesDetails:

To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
mechanismOfAction:
How DEXDINE INJECTION Works

DEXDINE INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use DEXDINE INJECTION

DEXDINE INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.

After you have been given this medicine, you must not drive, operate machinery or work in dangerous situations until the effects are completely gone. Ask your doctor when you can start doing these activities again and when you can go back to this kind of work.
Talk to your doctor about the use of alcohol after sedation/wake-up.
DEXDINE INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXDINE INJECTION.
DEXDINE INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXDINE INJECTION.
Do not receive this medicine if you are allergic to dexmedetomidine or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

DEXDINE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders (heart block grade 2 or 3), very low blood pressure which does not respond to> management. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

Others

DEXDINE INJECTION is not recommended for you, if you have:

Recently had a stroke or other serious condition affecting blood supply to the brain

Before receiving DEXDINE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have:

Low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding)
Neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke)
Ever developed a serious fever after taking some medicines called anaesthetics
Diabetes mellitus

Use in pediatrics:

The safety and efficacy of DEXDINE INJECTION in pediatric patients have not been established for procedural or ICU sedation. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXDINE INJECTION.

Use in geriatrics:

DEXDINE INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years due to increased risk of low heart rate and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About SHORTAL 5GM INJECTION

SHORTAL 5GM INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving SHORTAL 5GM INJECTION. Do not receive SHORTAL 5GM INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving SHORTAL 5GM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

SHORTAL 5GM INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. SHORTAL 5GM INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

How SHORTAL 5GM INJECTION Works

SHORTAL 5GM INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, SHORTAL 5GM INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

introduction:
Introduction About MIDZEE 5MG INJECTION

MIDZEE 5MG INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MIDZEE 5MG INJECTION. Do not receive MIDZEE 5MG INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MIDZEE 5MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MIDZEE 5MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MIDZEE 5MG INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

How MIDZEE 5MG INJECTION Works

MIDZEE 5MG INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MIDZEE 5MG INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOLNAP XR 6.5MG TABLET

ZOLNAP XR 6.5MG TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOLNAP XR 6.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOLNAP XR 6.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOLNAP XR 6.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOLNAP XR 6.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOLNAP XR 6.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOLNAP XR 6.5MG TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.

How ZOLNAP XR 6.5MG TABLET Works

ZOLNAP XR 6.5MG TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.

name: Midaspray Spray 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About MIDASPRAY SPRAY

MIDASPRAY SPRAY contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called benzodiazepines (sedatives). MIDASPRAY SPRAY is used to manage sudden repetitive attacks of fits (epilepsy). Epilepsy (fits) is a central nervous system (neurological) disorder which affects the brain creating a disturbance in nerve cells and electrical activity leading to sudden, uncontrolled body movements. Epilepsy can be triggered by sleep deprivation, stress, missing medications, illness with fever or using alcohol and other nonmedical drugs.

Before using MIDASPRAY SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have chronic respiratory problems, myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), a history of drug abuse or depression, narrow-angle glaucoma, sleep apnoea syndrome (sleep disorder in which breathing stops and starts repeatedly), kidney, heart, liver problems.

MIDASPRAY SPRAY is generally not recommended during pregnancy especially in the last trimester and breastfeeding, unless deemed necessary. MIDASPRAY SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly patients and children. MIDASPRAY SPRAY has a few side effects like nausea, vomiting, headache, drowsiness, runny nose, throat irritation, nasal discomfort and dizziness in some cases. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MIDASPRAY SPRAY

MIDASPRAY SPRAY nasal spray is used for emergencies to stop cluster seizures (episodes of increased seizure activity) in adults and children 12 years of age and older who are taking other medications to manage epilepsy (seizures).
mechanismOfAction:
How MIDASPRAY SPRAY Works

MIDASPRAY SPRAY contains midazolam which works by increasing a particular chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent (GABA) resulting in sedative, hypnotic (sleep-inducing), anxiolytic (anti-anxiety), anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant properties. Hence MIDASPRAY SPRAY helps manage fits by stabilizing the altered, electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use MIDASPRAY SPRAY

Use MIDASPRAY SPRAY as advised by your physician. MIDASPRAY SPRAY is for nasal use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after using MIDASPRAY SPRAY.
Do not drink alcohol if you are using MIDASPRAY SPRAY. This is because alcohol may make you feel very sleepy and cause problems with your breathing.

MIDASPRAY SPRAY should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Consult your doctor before using MIDASPRAY SPRAY.

Do not use MIDASPRAY SPRAY if you are allergic to midazolam. Allergic reactions to MIDASPRAY SPRAY are rare but may show as an itchy rash. Very rarely, a severe allergic reaction may occur causing a sudden onset of swelling of the face and neck, and shortness of breath.

MIDASPRAY SPRAY should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases. Consult your doctor before using MIDASPRAY SPRAY.

Have acute narrow-angle glaucoma

Regularly take recreational drugs or drink large amounts of alcohol or have had problems with alcohol or drug abuse in the past

MIDASPRAY SPRAY is used with caution for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before using it.

MIDASPRAY SPRAY should be used with caution in elderly (65 years and above) patients. Consult your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About MIDINTEN INJECTION

MIDINTEN INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MIDINTEN INJECTION. Do not receive MIDINTEN INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MIDINTEN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MIDINTEN INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MIDINTEN INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults

It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults

mechanismOfAction:
How MIDINTEN INJECTION Works

MIDINTEN INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MIDINTEN INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

MIDINTEN INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET

ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET contains Zolpidem, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Hypnotics. It is used in the short-term management of insomnia (sleeping disorder) in adults (above 18 years of age). The person with insomnia problems may have difficulty in sleeping, staying awake, or staying asleep, waking up too early etc.

ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or had myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), severe liver diseases, severe breathing problems, sleep apnoea (serious breathing problem while sleeping), psychosis (mental illness), somnambulism (sleepwalking) or abnormal behaviours after taking hypnotic medication in past.

ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from any heart problems which include irregular heartbeat, depression, or any other mental illness, in patients suffering from kidney disease, and in patients who have a history of alcohol and drug abuse.

ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 18 years of age. ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above age 65 years. The common side effects of taking ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET are impaired memory, hallucinations, sleeping problems that might get worse, headache, nightmares, nausea, vomiting, feeling drowsy during the day, etc. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your side effects get worse or if you experience abnormal behaviour or develop suicidal thoughts.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET
Short-term management of Insomnia (sleeping disorder)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET Works

ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET helps to manage insomnia. It works by increasing the level of a chemical in the brain called GABA, which blocks or slows down the activity of the brain to induce a calming effect.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET

Take ZOPENTA ER 6.25 TABLET as advised by your doctor. Do not crush or chew the medicine while consuming it with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dosage, and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXIT 100 MCG INJECTION

DEXIT 100 MCG INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

DEXIT 100 MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXIT 100 MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXIT 100 MCG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXIT 100 MCG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXIT 100 MCG INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures

mechanismOfAction:
How DEXIT 100 MCG INJECTION Works

DEXIT 100 MCG INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use DEXIT 100 MCG INJECTION

DEXIT 100 MCG INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.

name: Midosed Injection 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About MIDOSED INJECTION

MIDOSED INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MIDOSED INJECTION. Do not receive MIDOSED INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MIDOSED INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MIDOSED INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults

It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults

It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults
mechanismOfAction:
How MIDOSED INJECTION Works

MIDOSED INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MIDOSED INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.
usageDetails:
How to use MIDOSED INJECTION

MIDOSED INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Signs of a heart attack such as chest pain

Muscle spasm around the voice box, causing choking

warnings.details: MIDOSED INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receving the medicine.

MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Do not breastfeed for 24 hours after receiving MIDOSED INJECTION. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, sleepy forgetful or impaired concentration and coordination after receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving MIDOSED INJECTION because it may make you feel very sleepy and cause breathing problems.
MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.
MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.
Do not receive MIDOSED INJECTION if you are allergic to midazolam or other benzodiazepine medicines, such as diazepam or nitrazepam.
MIDOSED INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe breathing problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.
MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.

Others

Before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have an illness that makes you feel very weak, run down and short of energy
Have myasthenia gravis
Have sleep apnoea syndrome
Have ever had alcohol or drug problems

Use in paediatrics:

MIDOSED INJECTION should be cautious in infants, children and adolescents (less than 6 months to 16 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in geriatrics:

MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly (60 years and above) patients because there is an increased risk of fall, fractures and life-threatening side effects. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXIT 200 INJECTION

DEXIT 200 INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

DEXIT 200 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXIT 200 INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXIT 200 INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXIT 200 INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXIT 200 INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures

mechanismOfAction:
How DEXIT 200 INJECTION Works

DEXIT 200 INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use DEXIT 200 INJECTION

DEXIT 200 INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.

Others

Recently had a stroke or other serious condition affecting blood supply to the brain

Low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding)
Neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke)
Ever developed a serious fever after taking some medicines called anaesthetics
Diabetes mellitus

DEXIT 200 INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years due to increased risk of low heart rate and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About BENZOSED INJECTION

BENZOSED INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving BENZOSED INJECTION. Do not receive BENZOSED INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving BENZOSED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

BENZOSED INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. BENZOSED INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How BENZOSED INJECTION Works

BENZOSED INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, BENZOSED INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.
usageDetails:
How to use BENZOSED INJECTION

BENZOSED INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP

MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called benzodiazepines (sedatives). MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP is used to induce sleep during medical procedures or complicated tests known as procedural sedation which otherwise would be painful. Conscious sedation is a technique which uses a combination of medicines to help you relax (sedate) and to block pain and reduce anxiety during a medical procedure. You will stay awake but may not be able to speak while the procedure.

Before taking MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have chronic respiratory problems, myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), a history of drug abuse or depression, narrow-angle glaucoma, sleep apnoea syndrome (sleep disorder in which breathing stops and starts repeatedly), kidney, heart, liver problems.

MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP is generally not recommended during pregnancy, especially in the last trimester and while breastfeeding, unless deemed necessary. MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP should be used with caution in elderly patients and children. MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP has a few side effects like nausea, vomiting, headache, drowsiness, runny nose, throat irritation, nasal discomfort, and dizziness in some cases. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor immediately.
uses: For sedation before surgical or diagnostic procedures
usesDetails:

Short-term management of insomnia
For sedation before surgical or diagnostic procedures
mechanismOfAction:
How MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP Works

MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP contains midazolam which works by increasing a particular chemical messenger in the brain that acts as a natural nerve-calming agent (GABA) resulting in sedative, hypnotic (sleep-inducing), anxiolytic (anti-anxiety), anticonvulsant, and muscle relaxant properties. Hence MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP helps reduce anxiety and calm the patient.

Take MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP as advised by your physician. Shake the bottle well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Medicines for depression (Ex. citalopram)
Hypnotic medicines, to make you sleep (Ex. zopiclone)
Sedatives to make you feel calm or sleepy (Ex. barbiturates, benzodiazepines)
Tranquilliser medicines for anxiety or to help you sleep (Ex. pentobarbital)

Rifampicin to manage tuberculosis
Medicines for HIV called protease inhibitors (Ex. saquinavir)
Antibiotics to manage infection (Ex. erythromycin or clarithromycin)
Medicines to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, voriconazole, fluconazole, itraconazole, etc.)

Any kind of herbal medicine for depression
Medicines for high blood pressure (Ex. diltiazem)
Medicines used for the management of involuntary urine loss (Ex. propiverine)

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of MEZOLAM 7.5MG SYRUP, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are seldom life-threatening, if the drug is taken alone, but may lead to areflexia, apnoea, hypotonia, hypotension, cardiorespiratory depression, and rare cases of coma.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXMEDINE 100MCG INJECTION

DEXMEDINE 100MCG INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. name: Fulsed Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About FULSED INJECTION

FULSED INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving FULSED INJECTION. Do not receive FULSED INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving FULSED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

FULSED INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. FULSED INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults

Uses Of FULSED INJECTION
It is used as a general anaesthetic in adults
It is also used as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedures and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent in children and adults
mechanismOfAction:
How FULSED INJECTION Works

FULSED INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, FULSED INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

How to use FULSED INJECTION

FULSED INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Signs of a heart attack such as chest pain
Breathing problems, sometimes causing the breathing to stop
Muscle spasm around the voice box, causing choking

warnings.details: FULSED INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

FULSED INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Do not breastfeed for 24 hours after receiving FULSED INJECTION. Consult your doctor receiving receiving the medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, sleepy forgetful or impaired concentration and coordination after receiving FULSED INJECTION.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving FULSED INJECTION because it may make you feel very sleepy and cause breathing problems.
FULSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving FULSED INJECTION.
FULSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving FULSED INJECTION.
Do not receive FULSED INJECTION if you are allergic to midazolam or other benzodiazepine medicines, such as diazepam or nitrazepam.
FULSED INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe breathing problems. Consult your doctor before receiving FULSED INJECTION.
FULSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving FULSED INJECTION.

Others

Before receiving FULSED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have an illness that makes you feel very weak, run down and short of energy
Have myasthenia gravis
Have sleep apnoea syndrome
Have ever had alcohol or drug problems

Use in paediatrics:

FULSED INJECTION should be cautious in infants, children and adolescents (less than 6 months to 16 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in geriatrics:

FULSED INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly (60 years and above) patients because there is an increased risk of fall, fractures and life-threatening side effects. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About MIDOSED INJECTION

MIDOSED INJECTION contains Midazolam, which belongs to the group of medicines called central nervous system (CNS) depressants. It is used as a general anaesthetic (medications that put you in a sleep-like state before surgery) in adults.

It is also used in children and adults as preoperative sedation or conscious sedation (depressed level of consciousness during which a patient retains control over his protective reflexes and can respond) before the short diagnostic or endoscopic procedure and for induction of general anaesthesia before administration of another anaesthetic agent.

Avoid consuming alcohol while receiving MIDOSED INJECTION. Do not receive MIDOSED INJECTION if you have breathing difficulties. Before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, heart diseases, liver problems, a history of drug abuse, sleep apnoea syndrome and myasthenia gravis.

MIDOSED INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. MIDOSED INJECTION cause common side effects such as hiccups, cough, nausea and vomiting. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

How MIDOSED INJECTION Works

MIDOSED INJECTION works by acting on certain receptors in the brain called GABA receptors, which cause the release of a neurotransmitter called GABA that transmits messages between the nerve cells. Hence, MIDOSED INJECTION helps stabilize the altered electrical activity of nerve cells in the brain to induce complete loss of consciousness and for sedation before the surgical or diagnostic procedure.

MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.

MIDOSED INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe breathing problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.
MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Consult your doctor before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION.

Others

Before receiving MIDOSED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have an illness that makes you feel very weak, run down and short of energy
Have myasthenia gravis
Have sleep apnoea syndrome
Have ever had alcohol or drug problems

Use in paediatrics:

MIDOSED INJECTION should be cautious in infants, children and adolescents (less than 6 months to 16 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in geriatrics:

MIDOSED INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly (60 years and above) patients because there is an increased risk of fall, fractures and life-threatening side effects. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

name: Dexem 100mg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About DEXEM 100MG INJECTION

DEXEM 100MG INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

DEXEM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXEM 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXEM 100MG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

DEXEM 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXEM 100MG INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures

To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings

mechanismOfAction:
How DEXEM 100MG INJECTION Works

DEXEM 100MG INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use DEXEM 100MG INJECTION

DEXEM 100MG INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.

DEXEM 100MG INJECTION has major impact on the ability to drive and use machines. Ask your doctor when you can start doing these activities again and when you can go back to this kind of work.

Do not receive this medicine if you are allergic to dexmedetomidine or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

DEXEM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders (heart block grade 2 or 3), very low blood pressure which does not respond to> management. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

Others

DEXEM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for you, if you have:

Recently had a stroke or other serious condition affecting blood supply to the brain

Before receiving DEXEM 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have:

Low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding)
Neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke)
Ever developed a serious fever after taking some medicines called anaesthetics
Diabetes mellitus

The safety and efficacy of DEXEM 100MG INJECTION in pediatric patients have not been established for procedural or ICU sedation. Consult your doctor before receiving DEXEM 100MG INJECTION.

Use in geriatrics:

DEXEM 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years due to increased risk of low heart rate and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

name: SILENCE ANTI SNORING SPRAY 20ML
introduction:
Introduction About SILENCE

SILENCE ANTI SNORING SPRAY contains a patented formula (Phospholipids, Carrageenan and Rosehip extract) that helps to significantly reduce snoring throughout the night by acting on the main cause of it. It coats the back of your throat and lubricates it which is believed to reduce the incidence and volume of snoring while you are asleep.

Snoring happens when the air passes through the narrowed airways. SILENCE ANTI SNORING SPRAY directly acts on the main cause of snoring by effecting the soft palate and other soft tissues of the throat.

The effects of SILENCE ANTI SNORING SPRAY last throughout the night due to its adhesive formula. Spray this medicine at night before bedtime. For use, attach the mouthpiece and spray the medicine into the mouth and throat. Do not drink water or consume any foods after spraying the medicine.

SILENCE ANTI SNORING SPRAY is for oral use only. It is not meant for the management of sleep apnea. SILENCE ANTI SNORING SPRAY is not recommended for use in children aged below 10 years. Do not use SILENCE ANTI SNORING SPRAY if you are allergic to any of its ingredients or having allergy towards soy or peanuts.

Consult your doctor before using SILENCE ANTI SNORING SPRAY if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Do not use SILENCE ANTI SNORING SPRAY without consulting your doctor if you are asthmatic. Avoid contact of this spray with eyes. In case of accidental contact, wash your eyes with plenty of water. If irritation persists, consult your doctor.
